$comment: 签诗原文来自维基文库《關聖帝君靈籤》（清刊本，姑蘇鈕氏藏板），公有领域，保持原文繁体。reading（白话总解）、tale（典故故事）、aspects（分事项）是奥半仙依据维基文库该签页面的聖意、解曰、釋義、故事及記載自撰的白话，不是古籍原文；taleBasis 说明典故的依据（record 故事及記載 / history 正史 / legend 小说戏曲传说 / brief 只有简介）。classic 是维基文库该签页面的聖意、東坡解、碧仙註、解曰、釋義原文（只去掉了异文校记「■」、另一版本和现代补写的「功名：…」四字句），保持繁体。繁体由 scripts/i18n/build-zh-tw.ts 生成。

lots.story: 漢高祖入關　十八學土登瀛洲

reading.zh-CN: 这是一支气象极好的上签，好比一步步登上高处，在众人之中站到最前列。眼下的顺利是天时与自身努力共同促成的，名誉、福气和长久的安稳都可以期待。不过解签的人也提醒，好运来时如同骑在虎背上，越是得意越要谦和稳重，求财尤其要防有名无实。顺势而为、不骄不躁，这份福气才能长长久久。
reading.zh-TW: 這是一支氣象極好的上籤，好比一步步登上高處，在眾人之中站到最前列。眼下的順利是天時與自身努力共同促成的，名譽、福氣和長久的安穩都可以期待。不過解籤的人也提醒，好運來時如同騎在虎背上，越是得意越要謙和穩重，求財尤其要防有名無實。順勢而為、不驕不躁，這份福氣才能長長久久。
reading.en: This is a splendid lot: like climbing step by step to a high place, you are coming to stand at the very front. Your present good fortune is the fruit of good timing and your own effort, and honor, blessings and lasting security are all within reach. The old commentators add a caution, though: riding good luck is like riding a tiger, so the higher you rise, the more modest and steady you should be, and in money matters beware of gains that are more name than substance. Go with the tide without pride or haste, and this good fortune will last.

tale.zh-CN: 秦朝末年，楚怀王与诸将约定：谁先进入关中平定秦地，就让谁在关中称王。刘邦率军西进，抢先到达霸上，秦王子婴乘着素车白马，在轵道旁出降。刘邦进入咸阳后，封存了秦宫的府库财物，退军霸上，又与关中父老约定只保留三条法令，其余秦朝苛法一概废除，百姓十分欢喜。八百多年后，唐太宗还是秦王时开设文学馆，延揽杜如晦、房玄龄等十八位学士，命阎立本为他们画像，时人把入选称为“登瀛洲”。正如这支签说的，步步登高、名列前班，富贵福寿都是水到渠成。
tale.zh-TW: 秦朝末年，楚懷王與諸將約定：誰先進入關中平定秦地，就讓誰在關中稱王。劉邦率軍西進，搶先到達霸上，秦王子嬰乘著素車白馬，在軹道旁出降。劉邦進入咸陽後，封存了秦宮的府庫財物，退軍霸上，又與關中父老約定只保留三條法令，其餘秦朝苛法一概廢除，百姓十分歡喜。八百多年後，唐太宗還是秦王時開設文學館，延攬杜如晦、房玄齡等十八位學士，命閻立本為他們畫像，時人把入選稱為“登瀛洲”。正如這支籤說的，步步登高、名列前班，富貴福壽都是水到渠成。
tale.en: Toward the end of the Qin dynasty, King Huai of Chu promised his generals that whoever first entered the Guanzhong heartland and pacified Qin would be made its king. Liu Bang, who would go on to found the Han dynasty, pushed west and reached Bashang first, and Ziying, the last ruler of Qin, came out in a plain carriage drawn by white horses to surrender beside the road at Zhidao. Liu Bang sealed up the palace treasuries, pulled his troops back to Bashang, and agreed with the local elders to keep just three laws while abolishing Qin’s harsh code, to the people’s great joy. More than eight centuries later, the future Emperor Taizong of Tang, then Prince of Qin, founded an academy and gathered eighteen scholars, among them Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui, whose portraits were painted by Yan Liben; being chosen was called “ascending Yingzhou,” the isle of immortals. As this lot says, you are climbing step by step to the front rank, and wealth, honor and long life are arriving in their own time.

career.zh-CN: 事业顺遂，有机会脱颖而出、得到提拔重用，宜稳步推进。
career.zh-TW: 事業順遂，有機會脫穎而出、得到提拔重用，宜穩步推進。
career.en: Your work goes smoothly, with real chances to stand out and be promoted; keep moving forward steadily.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运平稳，但要防表面风光、实际落空，务实为上。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運平穩，但要防表面風光、實際落空，務實為上。
wealth.en: Finances are steady, but watch for gains that look good on paper yet prove hollow; stay practical.

love.zh-CN: 姻缘可成，彼此相合，适合推进关系。
love.zh-TW: 姻緣可成，彼此相合，適合推進關係。
love.en: A match can be made and you suit each other well; it is a good time to move the relationship forward.

travel.zh-CN: 出行顺利，远方的人也有望平安归来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行順利，遠方的人也有望平安歸來。
travel.en: Travel goes well, and those far away can be expected home safely.

exam.zh-CN: 考试功名有望，用心备考，容易名列前茅。
exam.zh-TW: 考試功名有望，用心備考，容易名列前茅。
exam.en: Exams look promising; prepare carefully and you may well finish near the top.

lost.zh-CN: 失物多半能寻回，可从常去的地方耐心找找。
lost.zh-TW: 失物多半能尋回，可從常去的地方耐心找找。
lost.en: Lost items will likely turn up; search patiently in the places you often go.

health.zh-CN: 精神状态不错也别透支，注意作息规律、劳逸结合，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 精神狀態不錯也別透支，注意作息規律、勞逸結合，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Even when you feel strong, don’t overdo it; keep regular hours, balance work and rest, and see a doctor if anything feels off.

shengyi: 功名遂　福祿全　訟得理　病即痊　桑麻熟　婚姻聯　孕生子　行人還
dongpo: 雲間獨步　拔萃超群　名登甲第　談笑功勳　終身光顯　皆天所相　祿厚壽高　意稱謀望
bixian: 月裏攀丹桂　成名步玉畿　求謀皆稱意　萬定定無疑
jieyue: 此籤謀望通達，無不遂意，但各有所主，官員占茲，有超越之喜，士人有功名之望，庶人不吉。若謀望，求財者，有名無實，為語多空虛也。
shiyi: 兩句顯仕者之進身。出玉殿千官之上。壽山福海皆天所付。 不可易得。故不應占。
得此者勢如騎虎。降得者吉。降不得者反被所傷。
千官或作仙官。

lots.story: 張子房遊赤松　韓蘄王西湖騎驢

reading.zh-CN: 世事有盈有亏，关键在于顺应时机，如今时运渐转，许多事都能顺手。前程看似遥远，其实可能比想象中近，只是不宜操之过急。解签的人反复叮嘱，最要紧的是端正心地、修养自身，不要轻举妄动。守住本心、按部就班，福气才走得长远。
reading.zh-TW: 世事有盈有虧，關鍵在於順應時機，如今時運漸轉，許多事都能順手。前程看似遙遠，其實可能比想像中近，只是不宜操之過急。解籤的人反覆叮囑，最要緊的是端正心地、修養自身，不要輕舉妄動。守住本心、按部就班，福氣才走得長遠。
reading.en: Life ebbs and flows, and what matters is moving with the times; now the tide is turning your way, and many things will fall into place. The road ahead may be shorter than it looks, but it is not one to rush. The commentators stress again and again that the key is to keep your heart upright and cultivate yourself, never acting rashly. Hold to your true self, take things step by step, and your blessings will go a long way.

tale.zh-CN: 张良字子房，是辅佐刘邦平定天下的谋臣，汉朝建立后被封为留侯。功成之后，他说自己愿意抛开人间俗事，追随仙人赤松子云游，于是学习辟谷导引之术，渐渐不问政事。南宋名将韩世忠一生抗金，战功赫赫，后来交出兵权，便闭门谢客，绝口不谈兵事，常常骑着驴、带着酒，只领一两个小童，在西湖边游赏自乐，死后被追封为蕲王。两人都懂得盈虚有时、进退有度。正如这支签说的，时运自有盈亏，修好自己的心，前路自然顺畅。
tale.zh-TW: 張良字子房，是輔佐劉邦平定天下的謀臣，漢朝建立後被封為留侯。功成之後，他說自己願意拋開人間俗事，追隨仙人赤松子雲遊，於是學習辟穀導引之術，漸漸不問政事。南宋名將韓世忠一生抗金，戰功赫赫，後來交出兵權，便閉門謝客，絕口不談兵事，常常騎著驢、帶著酒，只領一兩個小童，在西湖邊遊賞自樂，死後被追封為蘄王。兩人都懂得盈虛有時、進退有度。正如這支籤說的，時運自有盈虧，修好自己的心，前路自然順暢。
tale.en: Zhang Liang, styled Zifang, was the strategist who helped Liu Bang win the empire, and he was made Marquis of Liu when the Han dynasty was founded. Once his work was done, he said he wished to leave worldly affairs behind and roam with the immortal Master Red Pine, and he took up fasting and breathing exercises, gradually stepping back from affairs of state. Centuries later, Han Shizhong, a celebrated Southern Song general who spent his life fighting the Jin, gave up his command; he then closed his gate to visitors, never spoke of war again, and often rode a donkey with a flask of wine and a servant boy or two to enjoy West Lake. He was posthumously made Prince of Qi. Both men understood that every tide rises and falls, and knew when to step forward and when to step back. As this lot says, fortune waxes and wanes in its season; tend your heart well, and the road ahead will open by itself.

career.zh-CN: 事情能成，但要等待时机，切莫急躁冒进。
career.zh-TW: 事情能成，但要等待時機，切莫急躁冒進。
career.en: Things can work out, but wait for the right moment and don’t push ahead in a hurry.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运平平，稳中有得，不宜贪多求快。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運平平，穩中有得，不宜貪多求快。
wealth.en: Money is average but steady gains are possible; don’t chase too much too fast.

love.zh-CN: 姻缘和合，感情顺利，以真心相待更加美满。
love.zh-TW: 姻緣和合，感情順利，以真心相待更加美滿。
love.en: The match is harmonious and love goes smoothly; sincerity will make it sweeter still.

travel.zh-CN: 出行可以安排，盼望的人也会如期到来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行可以安排，盼望的人也會如期到來。
travel.en: Travel can go ahead, and the person you are waiting for will arrive as expected.

exam.zh-CN: 功名有望，只是来得稍迟，沉住气继续用功。
exam.zh-TW: 功名有望，只是來得稍遲，沉住氣繼續用功。
exam.en: Success in exams is possible but may come a little late; stay calm and keep studying.

lost.zh-CN: 不必心急，静心回想，慢慢寻找多有着落。
lost.zh-TW: 不必心急，靜心回想，慢慢尋找多有著落。
lost.en: Don’t panic; think back calmly and search patiently, and it will likely turn up.

health.zh-CN: 宜放松心情、规律作息，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 宜放鬆心情、規律作息，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Relax your mind and keep regular hours; see a doctor promptly if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 訟宜和　病宜禱　功名有　遲莫躁　求財平　問婚好　若妄為　身莫保
dongpo: 萬事乘除　隨時而處　否極泰來　事無齟齬　能保則吉　更當修為　切莫妄動　萬福來宜
bixian: 禍福從天降　心仁萬事宜　若還無妄作　災散禍消除
jieyue: 此籤謀望虛查，不宜速進，且須待時，方可成就。婚則合。訟宜和。求財有。行人至。孕生女。病宜禱　大槩，以正心修德為要。
shiyi: 盈滿也。虛空也。消窮也。息渙也。四者皆用天命。
卜者當順受。不可妄為。
前程歸縮地。言目下功名。期望遠大。必藉修為。
乃得病。不可保。訟不可。終其曰。君當百事宜。
若蓋勉人修為。心地至於縮地。乃縮千里於目前。半步可至。
此壺公授費長房之術也。

lots.story: 賈誼遇漢文帝　張公藝九世同居

reading.zh-CN: 衣食自有来处，不必整日焦虑操劳。这支签劝人安守本分、不要贪求，过分费心算计反而徒增烦恼。在家孝顺和睦，待人忠厚守信，内外都少有怨隙，麻烦自然难以近身。踏实做人、耐心等待时机，福气会慢慢到来。
reading.zh-TW: 衣食自有來處，不必整日焦慮操勞。這支籤勸人安守本分、不要貪求，過分費心算計反而徒增煩惱。在家孝順和睦，待人忠厚守信，內外都少有怨隙，麻煩自然難以近身。踏實做人、耐心等待時機，福氣會慢慢到來。
reading.en: Your food and clothing will come from where they are meant to, so there is no need to worry and toil all day. This lot advises you to keep to your proper place and not to grasp for more; too much scheming only adds to your troubles. Be loving and harmonious at home, loyal and honest with others, and with no grudges inside or out, trouble will find it hard to reach you. Live steadily, wait patiently for your time, and good fortune will arrive bit by bit.

tale.zh-CN: 西汉的贾谊年少有才名，经河南郡守吴公推荐，被汉文帝召为博士，当时他才二十多岁，是博士中最年轻的。每逢诏令交下讨论，老先生们答不上来，贾谊都能一一应对，一年之内便被破格提拔为太中大夫。唐代郓州寿张人张公艺，家族九代同居，北齐、隋、唐都曾表彰他家。唐高宗去泰山封禅，路过郓州，亲自到他家中询问和睦的缘由，张公艺请来纸笔，只写了一百多个“忍”字，高宗为之感动落泪。正如这支签说的，衣食自有来处，孝悌忠信、和睦忍让，福禄自然到来。
tale.zh-TW: 西漢的賈誼年少有才名，經河南郡守吳公推薦，被漢文帝召為博士，當時他才二十多歲，是博士中最年輕的。每逢詔令交下討論，老先生們答不上來，賈誼都能一一應對，一年之內便被破格提拔為太中大夫。唐代鄆州壽張人張公藝，家族九代同居，北齊、隋、唐都曾表彰他家。唐高宗去泰山封禪，路過鄆州，親自到他家中詢問和睦的緣由，張公藝請來紙筆，只寫了一百多個“忍”字，高宗為之感動落淚。正如這支籤說的，衣食自有來處，孝悌忠信、和睦忍讓，福祿自然到來。
tale.en: In the Western Han, the young Jia Yi was already famed for his talent. Recommended by Lord Wu, governor of Henan, he was summoned by Emperor Wen to serve as an academician while still in his twenties, the youngest of them all. Whenever an edict was put up for discussion and the older scholars had nothing to say, Jia Yi answered every point, and within a year he was promoted out of turn to Grand Palace Grandee. In the Tang, Zhang Gongyi of Shouzhang in Yunzhou lived with nine generations of his family under one roof, and his household was honored by the Northern Qi, the Sui and the Tang. When Emperor Gaozong passed by on his way to the great sacrifices at Mount Tai, he visited the home himself and asked how they kept such harmony; Zhang asked for paper and brush and simply wrote the character for “forbearance” more than a hundred times, moving the emperor to tears. As this lot says, your livelihood will come in its own way; be devoted to family, loyal and true, and blessings will follow.

career.zh-CN: 名利自有时机，谋事进展偏慢，宜守好本分、稳步积累。
career.zh-TW: 名利自有時機，謀事進展偏慢，宜守好本分、穩步積累。
career.en: Recognition will come in its time; progress is slow for now, so do your part well and build up steadily.

wealth.zh-CN: 求财平平，略有阻滞，不宜贪多冒进。
wealth.zh-TW: 求財平平，略有阻滯，不宜貪多冒進。
wealth.en: Income is modest and a little sluggish; don’t be greedy or take big risks.

love.zh-CN: 婚事不必急于一时，以诚相待、细水长流更稳妥。
love.zh-TW: 婚事不必急於一時，以誠相待、細水長流更穩妥。
love.en: There is no need to rush into marriage; sincerity and a slow, steady pace are the surer path.

travel.zh-CN: 出行宜从容安排，不必赶时间，平安为重。
travel.zh-TW: 出行宜從容安排，不必趕時間，平安為重。
travel.en: Plan trips at an easy pace without rushing; safety comes first.

exam.zh-CN: 成绩自有时机，安心备考、尽力而为，不必过度焦虑。
exam.zh-TW: 成績自有時機，安心備考、盡力而為，不必過度焦慮。
exam.en: Results will come in their own time; prepare calmly, do your best, and don’t let anxiety take over.

lost.zh-CN: 失物多在原处附近，安心细找，不必过于着急。
lost.zh-TW: 失物多在原處附近，安心細找，不必過於著急。
lost.en: The lost item is probably close to where you left it; search carefully and don’t fret.

health.zh-CN: 不要过度劳心，保证睡眠、起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 不要過度勞心，保證睡眠、起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Don’t overtax your mind; get enough sleep, keep regular hours, and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 問名利　自有時　訟和吉　病瘥遲　求財平　婚未宜　誼謹守　免憂疑
dongpo: 富貴前定　何須強求　從勞心力　反致傷憂　事親待人　動合循理　天必佑之　有泰無否
bixian: 隨緣安分　直道而行　心中無愧　自然和平
jieyue: 此籤，只宜守舊，不可貪求。但存中直，卻得兩平。謀事遲。求財阻。婚姻可。風水更。孕將生，宜蚤保，免憂驚。
shiyi: 生處有者。戒人凡事依本分。不可貪得。處家孝悌。則內無怨。處人忠信。則外無怨。毒害消矣。交財未穩。婚姻主遲。是非口舌。主散為宜。修身待時。不可徒勞心力。成字或作時字。

lots.story: 小秦王三跳澗　張翰憶鱸魚

reading.zh-CN: 去年诸事顺手，今年运势相比之下有所回落，这是时运的自然起伏，不必惊慌。眼下宜收敛脚步，不要急着开拓新事，先守住手中已有的成果。心存敬畏与善念，凡事多想一步、早做准备，就能把影响降到最低。稳住节奏，慢慢等待转机。
reading.zh-TW: 去年諸事順手，今年運勢相比之下有所回落，這是時運的自然起伏，不必驚慌。眼下宜收斂腳步，不要急著開拓新事，先守住手中已有的成果。心存敬畏與善念，凡事多想一步、早做準備，就能把影響降到最低。穩住節奏，慢慢等待轉機。
reading.en: Last year most things went your way; this year your luck has dipped by comparison, which is simply the natural rise and fall of fortune and nothing to fear. For now, rein in your steps and hold off on new ventures, protecting what you have already gained. Keep a reverent, kind heart, think one step further, and prepare early, and you will keep any setbacks small. Hold a steady pace and wait patiently for the turn.

tale.zh-CN: 西晋时，吴郡人张翰在齐王司马冏手下任大司马东曹掾。当时司马冏独揽大权，张翰对同乡顾荣说，天下纷乱、祸难未止，自己本是山林中人，并没有追逐功名的心思。后来他看见秋风吹起，想起家乡吴中的菰菜、莼羹和鲈鱼脍，感叹人生贵在适意，何必为求名位而远在数千里外做官，于是驾车回了家乡。不久司马冏兵败，人们都说张翰能够见机而动。正如这支签说的，时运有起有落，趁顺时及早打算、珍惜福分，就不会追悔莫及。
tale.zh-TW: 西晉時，吳郡人張翰在齊王司馬冏手下任大司馬東曹掾。當時司馬冏獨攬大權，張翰對同鄉顧榮說，天下紛亂、禍難未止，自己本是山林中人，並沒有追逐功名的心思。後來他看見秋風吹起，想起家鄉吳中的菰菜、蓴羹和鱸魚膾，感嘆人生貴在適意，何必為求名位而遠在數千裡外做官，於是駕車回了家鄉。不久司馬冏兵敗，人們都說張翰能夠見機而動。正如這支籤說的，時運有起有落，趁順時及早打算、珍惜福分，就不會追悔莫及。
tale.en: In the Western Jin, Zhang Han of Wu commandery served on the staff of Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, who then held all power at court. Zhang told his fellow townsman Gu Rong that the realm was in turmoil and its troubles far from over, and that he was a man of the hills and woods with no hunger for office. Later, seeing the autumn wind rise, he thought of the wild-rice stems, water-shield soup and sliced perch of his home in Wu, and reflected that life is best spent doing what suits you, not chasing rank thousands of miles from home; so he had his carriage made ready and went back. Before long Sima Jiong fell, and everyone said Zhang Han had read the signs in time. As this lot says, fortune rises and falls; plan early while things are good and cherish what you have, and you will have nothing to regret.

career.zh-CN: 眼下推进不易，宜守住现有岗位与成果，暂缓大的变动。
career.zh-TW: 眼下推進不易，宜守住現有崗位與成果，暫緩大的變動。
career.en: Progress is hard right now; hold on to your current role and results, and put big changes on hold.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运偏淡，交易买卖先缓一缓，量入为出。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運偏淡，交易買賣先緩一緩，量入為出。
wealth.en: Money is thin for now; slow down on deals and live within your means.

love.zh-CN: 婚事暂时难成，不必勉强，多一些耐心和体谅。
love.zh-TW: 婚事暫時難成，不必勉強，多一些耐心和體諒。
love.en: A marriage may not come together just yet; don’t force it, and offer patience and understanding.

travel.zh-CN: 路途多有阻滞，非必要的远行可以延后。
travel.zh-TW: 路途多有阻滯，非必要的遠行可以延後。
travel.en: The road is full of delays; postpone any long trip that isn’t necessary.

exam.zh-CN: 这段时间考运平平，宜沉下心来补足基础，以待下次。
exam.zh-TW: 這段時間考運平平，宜沉下心來補足基礎，以待下次。
exam.en: Exam luck is middling for now; settle down, shore up the basics, and aim for the next round.

lost.zh-CN: 失物不易寻回，不必过度执着，日后多加留意。
lost.zh-TW: 失物不易尋回，不必過度執著，日後多加留意。
lost.en: The lost item may be hard to recover; don’t dwell on it, and take more care in future.

health.zh-CN: 运势低落时更要照顾好身体，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 運勢低落時更要照顧好身體，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: When luck is low, look after yourself all the more; keep regular hours and see a doctor if anything feels wrong.

shengyi: 功名無　財祿輕　訟宜息　婚未成　病難癒　行阻程　若求吉　禱神明
dongpo: 先吉後凶　時運將否　謀事無成　頓非前比　秉誠禱神　以求福祉　若無遠慮　悔無及已
bixian: 好事連綿過　時衰禍漸來　頂天並拜地　庶可保無災
jieyue: 此籤吉事已去，凶將漸來。祈禱神明，以保平安。官事臨身，是非自見。凡事謀望主不成。求財交易不就。所為皆不利也。
shiyi: 去年相宜。已往之吉。今年運衰。見在之凶。瓣香告神。勸人早植善果。感格神明。庶可轉禍為福。若無神佛扶持。則福力衰謝。殃咎並臨。佇見噬臍之悔。將何 及哉。占者宜早修省也。

reading.zh-CN: 眼下身不由己，门庭冷清，好像深秋一般萧瑟。但这只是一段时运的低谷，并不会长久如此。等时节一转，许多事情会像草木逢春一样重新兴旺起来，不必过分忧愁。现在最要紧的是耐心守住，待时而动。
reading.zh-TW: 眼下身不由己，門庭冷清，好像深秋一般蕭瑟。但這只是一段時運的低谷，並不會長久如此。等時節一轉，許多事情會像草木逢春一樣重新興旺起來，不必過分憂愁。現在最要緊的是耐心守住，待時而動。
reading.en: For now you are not your own master, and your door is as quiet and chill as late autumn. But this is only a low stretch of fortune, not a permanent state. When the season turns, many things will flourish again like plants in spring, so there is no need to worry too much. What matters most now is to hold on patiently and move when the time is right.

tale.zh-CN: 北宋的吕蒙正是河南人，父亲吕龟图官至起居郎，却因宠爱侍妾，与妻子刘氏不和，把母子二人一起赶出了家门。吕蒙正跟着母亲，日子过得十分困顿窘迫，母亲也发誓不再改嫁。太平兴国二年，吕蒙正考中进士第一。做官以后，他把父母都接到身边奉养，照顾得十分周到。后来他官至宰相，宋朝开国以来三次入相的，只有赵普和他两人。民间戏曲里还流传着他早年寄身破窑、受尽冷眼的故事。正如这支签说的，一时的冷清萧索终会过去，时节一转，万事回春。
tale.zh-TW: 北宋的呂蒙正是河南人，父親呂龜圖官至起居郎，卻因寵愛侍妾，與妻子劉氏不和，把母子二人一起趕出了家門。呂蒙正跟著母親，日子過得十分困頓窘迫，母親也發誓不再改嫁。太平興國二年，呂蒙正考中進士第一。做官以後，他把父母都接到身邊奉養，照顧得十分周到。後來他官至宰相，宋朝開國以來三次入相的，只有趙普和他兩人。民間戲曲裡還流傳著他早年寄身破窯、受盡冷眼的故事。正如這支籤說的，一時的冷清蕭索終會過去，時節一轉，萬事回春。
tale.en: Lü Mengzheng of the Northern Song came from Henan. His father, Lü Guitu, a court diarist, favored his concubines and quarreled with his wife, Lady Liu, and in the end drove mother and son out of the house together. Mengzheng and his mother fell into hard and narrow times, and she vowed never to remarry. In 977 he placed first in the jinshi examination. Once in office, he brought both parents to live with him and cared for them devotedly. He went on to serve as chief minister three times, an honor shared since the dynasty’s founding only with Zhao Pu. Folk opera still tells of his early years sheltering in a broken-down kiln and enduring cold looks. As this lot says, a bleak and lonely season will pass, and when the time turns, everything comes back to life like spring.

career.zh-CN: 事业起步偏迟，暂时身不由己，耐心积累，转机就在后头。
career.zh-TW: 事業起步偏遲，暫時身不由己，耐心積累，轉機就在後頭。
career.en: Your career is off to a slow start and you have little say for now; keep building, and the turn is coming.

wealth.zh-CN: 近期开销偏多，宜节省守财，等时运好转再图发展。
wealth.zh-TW: 近期開銷偏多，宜節省守財，等時運好轉再圖發展。
wealth.en: Spending runs high lately; save and protect what you have, and expand once luck improves.

love.zh-CN: 婚姻大事要审慎考察，看清了再定，不必仓促。
love.zh-TW: 婚姻大事要審慎考察，看清了再定，不必倉促。
love.en: Weigh marriage carefully and decide only when you see clearly; there is no rush.

travel.zh-CN: 在外的人会归来，自己出行宜等时机合适再动身。
travel.zh-TW: 在外的人會歸來，自己出行宜等時機合適再動身。
travel.en: Those away will come home; for your own trips, wait until the timing is right.

exam.zh-CN: 功名来得稍迟，持续用功，时机一到自会有所收获。
exam.zh-TW: 功名來得稍遲，持續用功，時機一到自會有所收穫。
exam.en: Success may come a little late; keep working, and it will arrive in its season.

lost.zh-CN: 失物一时难见，耐心等待，日后或有着落。
lost.zh-TW: 失物一時難見，耐心等待，日後或有著落。
lost.en: The item may not show up right away; be patient, and it may turn up later.

health.zh-CN: 心情低落时注意调适，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 心情低落時注意調適，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: When your spirits are low, take care to lift them; keep regular hours and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 財祿耗　功名遲　訟終吉　病可醫　婚宜審　行人歸　待時至　百事宜
dongpo: 榮枯有時　不由人力　泰運將亨　終於否極　月日子丑　凡事皆吉　如木遇春　轉見榮益
bixian: 事有不如意　當存忍耐心
時來皆順受　福至禍無侵
jieyue: 此籤先憂後喜。三般者，心口意。十二時中卻得衣食。官員主有遷移之兆。應在子丑。凶者漸吉。事皆可望也。
shiyi: 三般句。有二解。一作心口意。三者游移不定。一作富貴壽。三者杳茫無據。總是不能自主之意。秋景冷落。門庭似此。蕭索可知。牛鼠交承。乃是子醜接續之際。言有好光景在後。至此才得遂意。萬事回春。言事事起發。如草木春日向榮。皆足賞心悅目。何憂之有哉。現須耐守為吉。

reading.zh-CN: 眼下事情推进吃力，每一小步都像走远路一样辛苦，不必再费心张罗场面。双方之间缺乏信任，与其一厢情愿地执着旧情，不如冷静看清局面。凡事谨慎周密、守住自己的本分，先讲道义再谈利益，不宜轻易变动。等彼此心平气和时，局面自会慢慢松动。
reading.zh-TW: 眼下事情推進吃力，每一小步都像走遠路一樣辛苦，不必再費心張羅場面。雙方之間缺乏信任，與其一廂情願地執著舊情，不如冷靜看清局面。凡事謹慎周密、守住自己的本分，先講道義再談利益，不宜輕易變動。等彼此心平氣和時，局面自會慢慢鬆動。
reading.en: Things are moving with difficulty right now; every small step feels like a long journey, so there is no point in putting on a show. Trust is lacking on both sides, and rather than clinging to old feelings, it is better to look at the situation calmly. Be careful and thorough, keep to your own ground, put fairness before profit, and avoid hasty changes. Once both sides have calmed down, the situation will gradually ease.

tale.zh-CN: 战国时，赵惠文王得到了珍贵的和氏璧，秦昭王派人送信，说愿意用十五座城来换。赵国怕受骗，又怕得罪秦国，蔺相如便自请带着璧出使秦国。秦王拿到璧后十分高兴，却绝口不提给城的事。蔺相如说璧上有点瑕疵，要指给秦王看，借机把璧拿回手中，靠着柱子，表示若秦王相逼，就与璧一同撞碎在柱上。秦王只好答应斋戒五日再受璧。蔺相如料定秦王不会真心交城，暗中让随从怀揣宝璧，从小路送回了赵国。正如这支签说的，彼此猜疑时不可一厢情愿，看清人心、守住分寸，才能保全自己。
tale.zh-TW: 戰國時，趙惠文王得到了珍貴的和氏璧，秦昭王派人送信，說願意用十五座城來換。趙國怕受騙，又怕得罪秦國，藺相如便自請帶著璧出使秦國。秦王拿到璧後十分高興，卻絕口不提給城的事。藺相如說璧上有點瑕疵，要指給秦王看，藉機把璧拿回手中，靠著柱子，表示若秦王相逼，就與璧一同撞碎在柱上。秦王只好答應齋戒五日再受璧。藺相如料定秦王不會真心交城，暗中讓隨從懷揣寶璧，從小路送回了趙國。正如這支籤說的，彼此猜疑時不可一廂情願，看清人心、守住分寸，才能保全自己。
tale.en: In the Warring States period, King Huiwen of Zhao came into possession of the famous He Jade, and King Zhao of Qin sent a letter offering fifteen cities in exchange. Zhao feared being cheated yet dared not offend Qin, so Lin Xiangru volunteered to carry the jade to Qin. The King of Qin was delighted with it but said nothing about the cities. Claiming the jade had a flaw he wished to point out, Lin took it back into his hands, stood against a pillar, and declared that if pressed he would smash both his head and the jade against it. The king had to agree to fast for five days before receiving it. Sure that Qin would never truly hand over the cities, Lin had an attendant hide the jade in his robes and carry it back to Zhao by a side road. As this lot says, when trust runs thin on both sides, don’t cling to wishful feelings; see people clearly and keep your footing, and you will keep yourself whole.

career.zh-CN: 推进阻力较大，不宜贸然变动，先守好本职、谨慎行事。
career.zh-TW: 推進阻力較大，不宜貿然變動，先守好本職、謹慎行事。
career.en: There is a lot of resistance; avoid sudden moves, do your own job well, and act with care.

wealth.zh-CN: 钱财容易散失，合作要先讲诚信，避免轻易投资或借贷。
wealth.zh-TW: 錢財容易散失，合作要先講誠信，避免輕易投資或借貸。
wealth.en: Money slips away easily; insist on good faith in any partnership and avoid casual investing or lending.

love.zh-CN: 双方心存疑虑，姻缘难以勉强，先坦诚沟通，不必执着旧情。
love.zh-TW: 雙方心存疑慮，姻緣難以勉強，先坦誠溝通，不必執著舊情。
love.en: Doubts run both ways and a match can’t be forced; talk honestly first and don’t cling to the past.

travel.zh-CN: 出行多费周折，等人归来也会迟一些，宜从容安排。
travel.zh-TW: 出行多費周折，等人歸來也會遲一些，宜從容安排。
travel.en: Trips involve extra hassle and those you await may be late; plan with plenty of slack.

exam.zh-CN: 这段时间考试不易如愿，稳扎稳打，把基础打牢。
exam.zh-TW: 這段時間考試不易如願，穩紮穩打，把基礎打牢。
exam.en: Exams may not go as hoped for now; work steadily and make your foundations solid.

lost.zh-CN: 失物难以马上找回，回想经手的人和地方，慢慢寻找。
lost.zh-TW: 失物難以馬上找回，回想經手的人和地方，慢慢尋找。
lost.en: It may not turn up right away; think back over who handled it and where, and search patiently.

health.zh-CN: 劳心之时注意放松，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 勞心之時注意放鬆，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: When your mind is weighed down, make time to relax; keep regular hours and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 功名無　財祿散　病難痊　防產難　婚不成　訟未判　行人遲　休嗟嘆
dongpo: 凡事勞心　有退無進　謀望不成　懷疑不信　求合未合　將圓未圓　只宜守己　不宜變遷
bixian: 兩下心平　中間卻好　先義後利　庶幾可保
jieyue: 此籤謂人類不齊，有陽為君子，陰為小人者，須防其面是實非之心。訟只可和。主有離開。凡事謹慎周密，庶不誤敗。
shiyi: 鼓瑟吹笙。小雅宴嘉賓之詩也。茍非其人。何勞為此。寸步萬里。言覿面不能相識。彼此懷疑。此人已不可交。此事已不可就。即應當幾立斷。若更以私意。憶彼濃情。不唯徒勞罔功。必將更受其累。休將二字。禁止之詞。戒占者急當自悟也。

reading.zh-CN: 这是一支上上签，说你本身就有天赋与根基，又遇到了能够提携指点的贵人。只要专心用功、一步步积累，不久就会有所成就，像炼成丹药一样水到渠成。到那时，过去的辛苦都会化作向上的阶梯。珍惜眼前的机缘，专注到底，不必多疑。
reading.zh-TW: 這是一支上上籤，說你本身就有天賦與根基，又遇到了能夠提攜指點的貴人。只要專心用功、一步步積累，不久就會有所成就，像煉成丹藥一樣水到渠成。到那時，過去的辛苦都會化作向上的階梯。珍惜眼前的機緣，專注到底，不必多疑。
reading.en: This is one of the very best lots: you have natural talent and a solid foundation, and you have met someone who can lift you up and guide you. If you focus and build up step by step, you will soon achieve something, as naturally as an elixir coming to completion. When that day comes, all your past effort will become a ladder upward. Treasure this opportunity, see it through with focus, and don’t let doubt hold you back.

tale.zh-CN: 相传吕洞宾名岩，号纯阳子，是唐代人，后来被民间奉为八仙之一。传说他早年读书应举，屡次没有考中，后来在长安的酒肆里遇见了仙人钟离权。元杂剧《黄粱梦》等故事说，钟离权让他在一场大梦中历尽荣华与沉浮，梦醒时锅里的黄粱饭还没有煮熟。吕洞宾由此看破世事，拜钟离权为师，入山修道炼丹，终于得道成仙。正如这支签说的，自身有根基，又遇到良师点拨，只要专心修炼，便有一飞冲天的一天。
tale.zh-TW: 相傳呂洞賓名巖，號純陽子，是唐代人，後來被民間奉為八仙之一。傳說他早年讀書應舉，屢次沒有考中，後來在長安的酒肆裡遇見了仙人鍾離權。元雜劇《黃粱夢》等故事說，鍾離權讓他在一場大夢中歷盡榮華與沉浮，夢醒時鍋裡的黃粱飯還沒有煮熟。呂洞賓由此看破世事，拜鍾離權為師，入山修道煉丹，終於得道成仙。正如這支籤說的，自身有根基，又遇到良師點撥，只要專心修煉，便有一飛沖天的一天。
tale.en: Legend has it that Lü Dongbin, named Yan and known as Master Chunyang, lived in the Tang dynasty and was later honored in folk belief as one of the Eight Immortals. The stories say he sat the civil examinations again and again without success, until he met the immortal Zhongli Quan in a wine shop in Chang’an. In tales such as the Yuan-dynasty play The Yellow Millet Dream, Zhongli sends him into a long dream of glory and downfall, and when he wakes, the millet in the pot is not yet cooked. Seeing through worldly ambition, Lü took Zhongli as his teacher, withdrew to the mountains to practice the arts of the elixir, and in time became an immortal. As this lot says, you have a natural gift and have met a guide who can lead you; keep practicing with a single mind, and one day you will soar.

career.zh-CN: 有贵人赏识推荐，谋事顺利，宜把握机会大展身手。
career.zh-TW: 有貴人賞識推薦，謀事順利，宜把握機會大展身手。
career.en: Someone influential appreciates and recommends you; plans go well, so seize the chance to show what you can do.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运丰厚，经营投入多有回报，但仍宜稳健。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運豐厚，經營投入多有回報，但仍宜穩健。
wealth.en: Wealth flows generously and efforts pay off handsomely, though it is still wise to stay prudent.

love.zh-CN: 姻缘和合，彼此投契，适合携手向前。
love.zh-TW: 姻緣和合，彼此投契，適合攜手向前。
love.en: The match is harmonious and you understand each other; it is a good time to move forward together.

travel.zh-CN: 出行顺利，盼望的人也会到来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行順利，盼望的人也會到來。
travel.en: Travel goes smoothly, and the one you are waiting for will arrive.

exam.zh-CN: 考运亨通，用心准备，容易得到意外的好评与佳绩。
exam.zh-TW: 考運亨通，用心準備，容易得到意外的好評與佳績。
exam.en: Exam luck is strong; prepare well and you may earn unexpected praise and excellent results.

lost.zh-CN: 常有贵人相助，失物有望找回。
lost.zh-TW: 常有貴人相助，失物有望找回。
lost.en: Helpful people are around you, and the lost item may well be found.

health.zh-CN: 保持良好作息，有不适时及早就医，听从医生建议。
health.zh-TW: 保持良好作息，有不適時及早就醫，聽從醫生建議。
health.en: Keep good habits, see a doctor early if you feel unwell, and follow medical advice.

shengyi: 圖名遂　求財豐　訟得理　病不凶　行人至　夢飛熊　陰地吉　婚姻合
dongpo: 天生富貴　況得神助　凡骨成仙　昇騰雲路　庶人遇貴　財物皆聚　百事大吉　何必疑慮
bixian: 問病三日內　須逢好手扶　若還求富貴　雲路是亨途
jieyue: 此籤貴人占之，有薦投之事。士人占之有不虞之譽。庶人占之有百倍之利。方外占之，有仙昇之期。病患占之，有醫藥之佑。……
shiyi: 鼓瑟吹笙。小雅宴嘉賓之詩也。茍非其人。何勞為此。寸步萬里。言覿面不能相識。彼此懷疑。此人已不可交。此事已不可就。即應當幾立斷。若更以私意。憶彼濃情。不唯徒勞罔功。必將更受其累。休將二字。禁止之詞。戒占者急當自悟也。

lots.story: 大舜耕歷山　伊尹耕莘樂道

reading.zh-CN: 过去一段时间辛苦付出却收获不多，如今运势转好，就像荒年之后迎来丰收。大环境安稳太平，无论读书、务农、做工还是经商，都少有烦忧。之前的努力没有白费，此时宜顺势经营、发挥所长。只是好运当头也要懂得守成，才能把这份喜气长久留住。
reading.zh-TW: 過去一段時間辛苦付出卻收穫不多，如今運勢轉好，就像荒年之後迎來豐收。大環境安穩太平，無論讀書、務農、做工還是經商，都少有煩憂。之前的努力沒有白費，此時宜順勢經營、發揮所長。只是好運當頭也要懂得守成，才能把這份喜氣長久留住。
reading.en: For some time you worked hard with little to show for it; now your luck is turning, like a bumper harvest after lean years. The wider world is calm and settled, and whether you study, farm, make things or trade, there is little to worry about. Your earlier efforts were not wasted, and now is the time to build on them and use your strengths. Even in good times, though, remember to protect what you have, so the joy can last.

tale.zh-CN: 据《史记·五帝本纪》，舜曾在历山耕种，历山一带的人受他感化，都互相让出田界；他在雷泽打鱼，在河滨制陶，所到之处风气都变得淳厚。他住的地方，一年聚成村落，两年成为城邑，三年便成了都会。尧听说他的贤德，便举用了他，后来把天下禅让给他。又据《孟子》记载，伊尹在有莘国的田野里耕种，以尧舜之道为乐，商汤三次派人带着礼物去聘请，他才出山辅佐商汤。正如这支签说的，多年辛勤耕耘终会迎来丰收，太平日子里，各行各业都少有烦忧。
tale.zh-TW: 據《史記·五帝本紀》，舜曾在歷山耕種，歷山一帶的人受他感化，都互相讓出田界；他在雷澤打魚，在河濱製陶，所到之處風氣都變得淳厚。他住的地方，一年聚成村落，兩年成為城邑，三年便成了都會。堯聽說他的賢德，便舉用了他，後來把天下禪讓給他。又據《孟子》記載，伊尹在有莘國的田野裡耕種，以堯舜之道為樂，商湯三次派人帶著禮物去聘請，他才出山輔佐商湯。正如這支籤說的，多年辛勤耕耘終會迎來豐收，太平日子裡，各行各業都少有煩憂。
tale.en: According to the Records of the Grand Historian, Shun once farmed at Mount Li, and the people there, moved by his example, began yielding field boundaries to one another; when he fished at Leize and made pottery by the river, the ways of each place grew kinder. Wherever he settled, in one year a village formed, in two a town, and in three a city. Hearing of his virtue, the sage-king Yao raised him up and later passed the realm on to him. Mencius records that Yi Yin farmed in the fields of Youshen, delighting in the ways of Yao and Shun, and only after King Tang of Shang had sent envoys with gifts three times did he come out to serve him. As this lot says, years of patient tilling will bring their harvest, and in peaceful days every trade can go about its work without worry.

career.zh-CN: 时运由否转泰，努力得到认可，可适当调整方向、积极谋划。
career.zh-TW: 時運由否轉泰，努力得到認可，可適當調整方向、積極謀劃。
career.en: Fortune turns from hard to easy and your efforts are recognized; feel free to adjust course and plan boldly.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运转旺，付出多有回报，收益可观。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運轉旺，付出多有回報，收益可觀。
wealth.en: Money picks up; your efforts are rewarded and the returns are good.

love.zh-CN: 喜事临门，感情和顺，适合谈婚论嫁。
love.zh-TW: 喜事臨門，感情和順，適合談婚論嫁。
love.en: Happy news is on the way and love is harmonious; a good time to talk of marriage.

travel.zh-CN: 出行顺利，在外的人很快就会归来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行順利，在外的人很快就會歸來。
travel.en: Travel goes well, and those who are away will soon be back.

exam.zh-CN: 考试有望被录取或获得推荐，多年用功将见成效。
exam.zh-TW: 考試有望被錄取或獲得推薦，多年用功將見成效。
exam.en: You may be admitted or recommended; years of study are about to pay off.

lost.zh-CN: 失物有望找回，多留意平时放置的地方。
lost.zh-TW: 失物有望找回，多留意平時放置的地方。
lost.en: The item can likely be found; check the places where you usually keep things.

health.zh-CN: 心情舒畅之余也要劳逸结合，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 心情舒暢之餘也要勞逸結合，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Even in good spirits, balance work and rest, keep regular hours, and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 士領薦　人獲財　訟即解　病無災　問行人　即便回　謀望吉　喜慶來
dongpo: 凡事求謀　昔否今泰　時運將亨　有喜無害　士農工商　悉逢嘉會　財物倍收　普均內外
bixian: 時否今逢泰　尤當要守成　不論貧與富　從此盡通亨
jieyue: 此籤宜改圖謀利凡百事實踐之人皆有望問病占訟先憂後喜日孕生男風水吉利子孫亨嘉也
shiyi: 耕稼無收。指往事失意。今歲有秋。指現在利益。太平日。大有俯仰優遊之樂。百無憂。統言士農工商之儔。占此者。人人獲吉。事事如意。喜氣洋溢之兆也。

lots.story: 宋太祖陳橋即位　張京兆畫眉

reading.zh-CN: 一直盼望远方的消息，时常对镜细看、心中挂念，如今好消息终于要到了。久等的事情即将有着落，喜悦已经写在脸上。不过解签的人也提醒，凡事久而后成、难而后易，越是临近越不要心急，也不要只凭空指望。安心等候、踏实准备，好事自会稳稳到来。
reading.zh-TW: 一直盼望遠方的訊息，時常對鏡細看、心中掛念，如今好訊息終於要到了。久等的事情即將有著落，喜悅已經寫在臉上。不過解籤的人也提醒，凡事久而後成、難而後易，越是臨近越不要心急，也不要只憑空指望。安心等候、踏實準備，好事自會穩穩到來。
reading.en: You have long been waiting for news from afar, often gazing into the mirror with your heart full of longing, and now the good news is finally on its way. What you have waited for is about to be settled, and the joy already shows on your face. The commentators add that things that take long come right in the end and hard things grow easy, so the closer it gets, the less you should rush, and don’t rely on hope alone. Wait calmly, prepare steadily, and the good things will arrive safely.

tale.zh-CN: 后周显德七年春天，边境奏报北汉联合契丹入侵，朝廷命殿前都点检赵匡胤领兵抵御。大军走到京城东北的陈桥驿，将士们把黄袍披在他身上，拥立他为天子。赵匡胤回到京城，后周恭帝禅位，他改国号为宋，就是宋太祖。西汉时，张敞担任京兆尹，常在家中为妻子画眉，长安城里都传说张京兆画的眉很妩媚。有官员把这事报告给汉宣帝，宣帝问起，张敞回答说，夫妻之间的私事，比画眉更亲密的还多着呢，宣帝也就没有责怪他。正如这支签说的，久盼的好消息就要到来，喜色已上眉梢。
tale.zh-TW: 後周顯德七年春天，邊境奏報北漢聯合契丹入侵，朝廷命殿前都點檢趙匡胤領兵抵禦。大軍走到京城東北的陳橋驛，將士們把黃袍披在他身上，擁立他為天子。趙匡胤回到京城，後周恭帝禪位，他改國號為宋，就是宋太祖。西漢時，張敞擔任京兆尹，常在家中為妻子畫眉，長安城裡都傳說張京兆畫的眉很嫵媚。有官員把這事報告給漢宣帝，宣帝問起，張敞回答說，夫妻之間的私事，比畫眉更親密的還多著呢，宣帝也就沒有責怪他。正如這支籤說的，久盼的好訊息就要到來，喜色已上眉梢。
tale.en: In the spring of the seventh year of Xiande in the Later Zhou, the border reported that the Northern Han and the Khitans were invading together, and the court sent Zhao Kuangyin, commander of the palace army, to meet them. At Chenqiao post station, northeast of the capital, his officers draped a yellow imperial robe over him and acclaimed him emperor. Returning to the capital, he received the abdication of the young Emperor Gong and named his new dynasty Song; he is remembered as Emperor Taizu. Back in the Western Han, Zhang Chang, governor of the capital region, used to paint his wife’s eyebrows, and all Chang’an talked about how charming “Governor Zhang’s brows” were. When officials reported this to Emperor Xuan and the emperor asked about it, Zhang replied that between husband and wife there are private matters far more intimate than painting eyebrows, and the emperor let it go. As this lot says, the good news you have long awaited is on its way, and joy is already rising to your brow.

career.zh-CN: 期盼已久的机会即将到来，可能有升迁或好消息，宜做好准备。
career.zh-TW: 期盼已久的機會即將到來，可能有升遷或好訊息，宜做好準備。
career.en: A long-awaited opportunity is close, perhaps a promotion or good news; get ready for it.

wealth.zh-CN: 求财有望，等待中的款项或生意多有回音，但仍要落到实处。
wealth.zh-TW: 求財有望，等待中的款項或生意多有迴音，但仍要落到實處。
wealth.en: Money matters look hopeful and pending payments or deals should get a response, but keep your plans concrete.

love.zh-CN: 姻缘可求，彼此情意相通，感情甜蜜和顺。
love.zh-TW: 姻緣可求，彼此情意相通，感情甜蜜和順。
love.en: A match can be sought; your feelings are mutual and love is sweet and smooth.

travel.zh-CN: 出行顺利，盼望的人不久就会到来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行順利，盼望的人不久就會到來。
travel.en: Travel goes well, and the one you are waiting for will arrive before long.

exam.zh-CN: 考试有望传来好消息，安心应考即可。
exam.zh-TW: 考試有望傳來好訊息，安心應考即可。
exam.en: Good news from your exams is likely; just sit them with a calm mind.

lost.zh-CN: 失物不久可能有消息，留意旁人的转告。
lost.zh-TW: 失物不久可能有訊息，留意旁人的轉告。
lost.en: You may hear about the lost item soon; listen for word from others.

health.zh-CN: 心情愉快有益身心，仍要起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 心情愉快有益身心，仍要起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: A happy mood helps body and mind; still keep regular hours and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 名與利　必至頭　訟必勝　病即瘳　孕生男　婚可求　行人至　百無憂
dongpo: 謀望已久　忽得好音　音書到手　喜在目今　利有攸往　財獲千金　所謀遂意　凡事稱心
bixian: 行人若久望　只在三日至　自去自回歸　不出百日內
jieyue: 此簽謀為之事。旦夕喜信。若問行人。旦夕即至。婚姻和合。疾病回頭。士子科名捷報。仕宦得位超遷。叩問運程。即見好訊息也。
shiyi: 望訊息。等待已久也。仔細看。把鏡自照也。此是盼望不寧之狀。文書入境。訊息已到。喜色眉端。大有揚眉吐氣之概。凡事久而後成。難而後易。不可過急。

lots.story: 冉伯牛染病　孟郊五十登第

reading.zh-CN: 近来身体和运气都有些低迷，做事处处不顺，这时不必四处问卜、心神不宁。与其向外求索，不如先安顿好自己，调养身心、反省修整。等到冬去春来、一阳来复，时运回升，再出手谋事会更有成效。眼下宜守旧、不贪求，耐心等待转机。
reading.zh-TW: 近來身體和運氣都有些低迷，做事處處不順，這時不必四處問卜、心神不寧。與其向外求索，不如先安頓好自己，調養身心、反省修整。等到冬去春來、一陽來復，時運回升，再出手謀事會更有成效。眼下宜守舊、不貪求，耐心等待轉機。
reading.en: Lately both your health and your luck have been low, and nothing seems to go smoothly; this is no time to chase one fortune-teller after another in a restless state. Rather than seeking answers outside, first settle yourself: rest, recover and take stock. When winter gives way to spring and the light returns, your fortune will rise again, and that is the time to make your moves. For now, keep to familiar ground, don’t grasp for more, and wait patiently for the turn.

tale.zh-CN: 冉伯牛是孔子的弟子，以德行著称，却身患重病。孔子去探望他，从窗外握住他的手，感叹这样好的人竟得了这样的病，只能说是命啊。唐代诗人孟郊，字东野，湖州武康人，年轻时隐居嵩山，性情耿介，不善与人周旋，韩愈却一见到他就与他结为知己。他直到五十岁才考中进士，被任命为溧阳县尉。一个是德行出众却遭逢病痛，一个是大器晚成、迟来得志。正如这支签说的，运势低迷时不必四处问卜，先安顿好自己，等到一阳来复，转机自然出现。
tale.zh-TW: 冉伯牛是孔子的弟子，以德行著稱，卻身患重病。孔子去探望他，從窗外握住他的手，感嘆這樣好的人竟得了這樣的病，只能說是命啊。唐代詩人孟郊，字東野，湖州武康人，年輕時隱居嵩山，性情耿介，不善與人周旋，韓愈卻一見到他就與他結為知己。他直到五十歲才考中進士，被任命為溧陽縣尉。一個是德行出眾卻遭逢病痛，一個是大器晚成、遲來得志。正如這支籤說的，運勢低迷時不必四處問卜，先安頓好自己，等到一陽來復，轉機自然出現。
tale.en: Ran Boniu, a disciple of Confucius, was known for his virtue, yet he fell gravely ill. When Confucius went to see him, he held his hand through the window and lamented that such a good man should suffer such an illness; it could only be fate. Meng Jiao, styled Dongye, was a Tang poet from Wukang in Huzhou. As a young man he lived in seclusion on Mount Song; upright and unbending, he found it hard to get along with people, yet Han Yu took him as a close friend at their first meeting. Only at fifty did he pass the jinshi examination, after which he was appointed sheriff of Liyang county. One man of great virtue met with illness; the other found success late in life. As this lot says, when luck runs low there is no need to seek omen after omen; take care of yourself first, and when the light returns, the turn will come.

career.zh-CN: 眼下谋事不易，宜守住旧业，等时运回升再作打算。
career.zh-TW: 眼下謀事不易，宜守住舊業，等時運回升再作打算。
career.en: New plans are hard to get off the ground; stick with what you have and decide again when fortune rises.

wealth.zh-CN: 钱财容易流失，不宜贪求冒进，先稳住开支。
wealth.zh-TW: 錢財容易流失，不宜貪求冒進，先穩住開支。
wealth.en: Money slips away easily; don’t chase gains or take risks, and keep spending under control.

love.zh-CN: 感情宜顺其自然，彼此多体谅，不必急于求成。
love.zh-TW: 感情宜順其自然，彼此多體諒，不必急於求成。
love.en: Let love take its natural course, be understanding with each other, and don’t rush things.

travel.zh-CN: 远行多有拖延，盼望的人归来也会迟一些。
travel.zh-TW: 遠行多有拖延，盼望的人歸來也會遲一些。
travel.en: Long trips are prone to delays, and those you await may be late coming home.

exam.zh-CN: 功名一时难求，像孟郊一样厚积薄发，坚持终有回报。
exam.zh-TW: 功名一時難求，像孟郊一樣厚積薄發，堅持終有回報。
exam.en: Success may not come quickly; like Meng Jiao, keep building, and persistence will pay off.

lost.zh-CN: 失物一时难寻，不必过于挂心，日后或有转机。
lost.zh-TW: 失物一時難尋，不必過於掛心，日後或有轉機。
lost.en: The item is hard to find for now; don’t let it weigh on you, it may turn up later.

health.zh-CN: 多休息、起居规律，身体不适要及时就医，不要硬撑。
health.zh-TW: 多休息、起居規律，身體不適要及時就醫，不要硬撐。
health.en: Rest more and keep regular hours; if you feel unwell, see a doctor promptly rather than pushing through.

shengyi: 名難圖　財祿失　行人遲　訟未息　病留連　求神佑　莫貪求　宜守舊
dongpo: 命運多蹇　疾病連緜　但宜修省　托庇蒼天　直須冬至　禱神方痊　凡百謀望　作事必全
bixian: 旡妄過凶災　陰人口舌來　一亦生日後　漸漸福緣開
jieyue: (待錄入)
shiyi: (待錄入)

reading.zh-CN: 今年看起来好事接连、风光一时，但世事变化难以预料，表面的顺利未必稳固。越是得意的时候，越要知足、谨慎，凡事不可贪求，也不要把计划轻易透露给旁人。若只顾一味往前冲，最后容易落得孤立无援、白白伤神。见机而作、多留余地，才能守住眼前的福分。
reading.zh-TW: 今年看起來好事接連、風光一時，但世事變化難以預料，表面的順利未必穩固。越是得意的時候，越要知足、謹慎，凡事不可貪求，也不要把計劃輕易透露給旁人。若只顧一味往前衝，最後容易落得孤立無援、白白傷神。見機而作、多留餘地，才能守住眼前的福分。
reading.en: This year good things seem to come one after another, but the world changes in ways no one can predict, and surface success may not be solid. The better things go, the more you should be content and careful: don’t grasp for more, and don’t share your plans too freely. If you only charge ahead, you may end up alone and heartsore. Read the situation, leave yourself some room, and you will keep the blessings you have.

tale.zh-CN: 韩信是淮阴人，辅佐汉高祖刘邦平定天下，俘虏魏王，攻破赵国，收降燕国，平定齐地，又协同灭楚，功劳极大，起初被封为楚王。高祖深深忌惮他的才能，假称巡游云梦泽，趁韩信前来拜见时将他拿下，带回后降封为淮阴侯。韩信却不懂得收敛克制，常常夸耀自己的功劳，心怀不平。据《史记》记载，后来他被吕后和萧何设计，在长乐宫被杀，家族也受到牵连。功劳虽大，却未能长久。正如这支签说的，得意时更要谦逊收敛，世事难料，多留余地才能走得长远。
tale.zh-TW: 韓信是淮陰人，輔佐漢高祖劉邦平定天下，俘虜魏王，攻破趙國，收降燕國，平定齊地，又協同滅楚，功勞極大，起初被封為楚王。高祖深深忌憚他的才能，假稱巡遊雲夢澤，趁韓信前來拜見時將他拿下，帶回後降封為淮陰侯。韓信卻不懂得收斂剋制，常常誇耀自己的功勞，心懷不平。據《史記》記載，後來他被呂后和蕭何設計，在長樂宮被殺，家族也受到牽連。功勞雖大，卻未能長久。正如這支籤說的，得意時更要謙遜收斂，世事難料，多留餘地才能走得長遠。
tale.en: Han Xin of Huaiyin, the general who helped Liu Bang found the Han dynasty, captured the King of Wei, crushed Zhao, won the surrender of Yan, conquered Qi and joined in the final defeat of Chu. At first he was made King of Chu, but Emperor Gaozu deeply feared his talent; pretending to tour the Yunmeng marshes, the emperor seized Han Xin when he came to pay his respects, brought him back and demoted him to Marquis of Huaiyin. Han Xin would not hold himself back; he kept boasting of his merits and nursing resentment. According to the Records of the Grand Historian, he was later lured into a trap by Empress Lü and the chancellor Xiao He and put to death in the Changle Palace, and his clan suffered with him. His achievements were great, but they did not last. As this lot says, when things go your way, stay humble; the world is hard to predict, and leaving yourself room is what lets you go far.

career.zh-CN: 名位一时难成，宜守本分、靠一技之长立身，不要锋芒太露。
career.zh-TW: 名位一時難成，宜守本分、靠一技之長立身，不要鋒芒太露。
career.en: Advancement is hard to secure for now; keep to your role, rely on your skills, and don’t show off.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运平平，不可强求，暂且守成、知足为上。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運平平，不可強求，暫且守成、知足為上。
wealth.en: Finances are average; don’t force things, hold on to what you have, and be content.

love.zh-CN: 这段缘分看似合适，内里未必相合，宜冷静考虑，不宜仓促结合。
love.zh-TW: 這段緣分看似合適，內裡未必相合，宜冷靜考慮，不宜倉促結合。
love.en: This match may look right on the outside but not fit underneath; think it over calmly before committing.

travel.zh-CN: 时机未到，远行多有阻滞，暂缓为好。
travel.zh-TW: 時機未到，遠行多有阻滯，暫緩為好。
travel.en: The timing isn’t right and trips may run into obstacles; better to wait.

exam.zh-CN: 不必强求一时的结果，扎实学好本领，比一时得失更重要。
exam.zh-TW: 不必強求一時的結果，紮實學好本領，比一時得失更重要。
exam.en: Don’t fixate on one result; building real skill matters more than any single outcome.

lost.zh-CN: 失物未必能追回，权当提醒，今后多加小心。
lost.zh-TW: 失物未必能追回，權當提醒，今後多加小心。
lost.en: The item may not come back; take it as a reminder to be more careful from now on.

health.zh-CN: 宜放慢脚步，作息规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 宜放慢腳步，作息規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Slow down, keep regular hours, and see a doctor promptly if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 莫貪求。名未遂。財祿平。訟不利。
病者凶。事不濟。問行人。多阻滯。
dongpo: 命運難亨。亦不如意。吉中有凶。事實無濟。
切莫貪求。出外不利。如或妄動。福消禍至。
bixian: 作事須宜慎。人心隔肚皮。
用心防算險。百事自合宜。
jieyue: 此籤宜更改方得財祿。要知足。
不可與人其事。恐機事不密。反成禍敗。
官有旌麾之喜。孕生男。士有超拔之喜。訟者勝。婚不吉。
shiyi: 此籤卻要知道吾人處世。當見機而作。今年命運。雖吉未吉。似亨未亨。
欲問孕生男。終難長養。底於有成。難料處言。事有變幻。
凡事占之徒勞心力。若強為。到底無益。立字一作力字。

reading.zh-CN: 原本盼着早些把事情办成，没想到一拖再拖，到头来仍不如意。这支签的意思是先忧后定：单靠自己难有进展，要等到遇见可靠的贵人扶持，生活才会真正安稳下来。这段时间不要轻信闲话、托付非人，也不必四处乱求、徒费心力。踏实修身、耐心等待，时机到了自会安定。
reading.zh-TW: 原本盼著早些把事情辦成，沒想到一拖再拖，到頭來仍不如意。這支籤的意思是先憂後定：單靠自己難有進展，要等到遇見可靠的貴人扶持，生活才會真正安穩下來。這段時間不要輕信閒話、託付非人，也不必四處亂求、徒費心力。踏實修身、耐心等待，時機到了自會安定。
reading.en: You hoped to get things done early, but they have dragged on and still haven’t turned out as you wished. This lot moves from worry to settlement: on your own it is hard to make headway, and life will truly settle once you meet a reliable person of standing who lends a hand. In the meantime, don’t believe idle talk or trust the wrong people, and don’t wear yourself out seeking help everywhere. Cultivate yourself steadily and wait patiently; when the time comes, things will settle.

tale.zh-CN: 苏武字子卿，西汉杜陵人。汉武帝天汉元年，他以中郎将的身份持节出使匈奴，却被扣留。匈奴把他关进大地窖，断绝饮食，他嚼着雪和毡毛咽下，几天都没有倒下。后来匈奴又把他流放到北海边无人之处，让他放牧公羊。苏武手持汉朝的符节牧羊，节上的旄毛都掉光了，始终不肯屈服。他在匈奴前后十九年，直到汉昭帝时才得以回国，被任命为典属国。汉宣帝即位后赐他关内侯的爵位，画像也被列入麒麟阁。正如这支签说的，眼下虽一再落空，坚持守节，终会等来安稳的一天。
tale.zh-TW: 蘇武字子卿，西漢杜陵人。漢武帝天漢元年，他以中郎將的身份持節出使匈奴，卻被扣留。匈奴把他關進大地窖，斷絕飲食，他嚼著雪和氈毛嚥下，幾天都沒有倒下。後來匈奴又把他流放到北海邊無人之處，讓他放牧公羊。蘇武手持漢朝的符節牧羊，節上的旄毛都掉光了，始終不肯屈服。他在匈奴前後十九年，直到漢昭帝時才得以回國，被任命為典屬國。漢宣帝即位後賜他關內侯的爵位，畫像也被列入麒麟閣。正如這支籤說的，眼下雖一再落空，堅持守節，終會等來安穩的一天。
tale.en: Su Wu, styled Ziqing, came from Duling in the Western Han. In the first year of Tianhan under Emperor Wu, he carried the imperial tally as envoy to the Xiongnu and was detained. The Xiongnu shut him in a great pit without food or drink, and he survived for days by chewing snow together with strands of felt. Later they exiled him to the empty shores of the Northern Sea and set him to herding rams. He tended the flock holding the Han envoy’s staff until its tassels had all fallen away, and he never gave in. After nineteen years he finally returned under Emperor Zhao and was made Director of Dependent States; Emperor Xuan later made him a marquis, and his portrait hung in the Qilin Pavilion among the dynasty’s worthies. As this lot says, even when hopes fall through again and again, holding fast will bring you to a settled life at last.

career.zh-CN: 谋事需要有贵人提携才能成功，眼下宜稳扎稳打，留心身边可靠的人。
career.zh-TW: 謀事需要有貴人提攜才能成功，眼下宜穩紮穩打，留心身邊可靠的人。
career.en: Success needs a mentor’s backing; work steadily for now and keep an eye out for trustworthy people.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运平平，属于过渡时期，守住则安，急进反而吃亏。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運平平，屬於過渡時期，守住則安，急進反而吃虧。
wealth.en: Money is flat in this transitional period; holding steady keeps you safe, while rushing will cost you.

love.zh-CN: 感情宜理智看待，若彼此不合，不必勉强。
love.zh-TW: 感情宜理智看待，若彼此不合，不必勉強。
love.en: Look at the relationship with a clear head; if you aren’t right for each other, don’t force it.

travel.zh-CN: 近期不宜远行，在外的人则会归来。
travel.zh-TW: 近期不宜遠行，在外的人則會歸來。
travel.en: It’s not a good time for long trips, but those who are away will come home.

exam.zh-CN: 功名来得稍迟，持续用功，待时而发。
exam.zh-TW: 功名來得稍遲，持續用功，待時而發。
exam.en: Success may come a little late; keep studying and wait for your moment.

lost.zh-CN: 失物难以追回，不必再追，今后多加小心。
lost.zh-TW: 失物難以追回，不必再追，今後多加小心。
lost.en: The item is unlikely to come back; let it go and take more care in future.

health.zh-CN: 宜静心调养，起居规律，有不适要找可靠的医生及时就诊。
health.zh-TW: 宜靜心調養，起居規律，有不適要找可靠的醫生及時就診。
health.en: Rest quietly and keep regular hours; if you feel unwell, see a trusted doctor promptly.

shengyi: 求名遲。財未至。病改醫。訟最忌。
行人歸。孕生貴。顯宦遇。方吉利。
dongpo: 作事遲疑。求財未遂。臨江貴人。望之如意。
萬一他求。徒勞心志。且謹踐修。以俟時至。
bixian: 凡事苦難成。好處反傷情。
好人為主宰。謀望盡皆亨。
jieyue: 此籤先憂繼疑。最後始定。
謀事須托。傍人扶持。或官場或紳士。方能有成。
訟宜休。病擇醫。直到秋散後。始獲安全。
慎勿誤聽讒言。信任非人可也。
shiyi: 營為在春間。主多遂意。交至秋分。則否。
大抵始吉終凶。清江貴人。謂遠方貴顯之人也。
遇之扶持。則百事遂意。
舍此他求。徒勞心力財貨。至秋必主清廢。
訟有變。主貴人和解。

reading.zh-CN: 你现在时运还未通达，凡事推进较慢，不必心急。不妨像江边垂钓的人一样，沉住气、守住本分，把本事收藏好，等待合适的时机。这段时间宜守不宜进，不要轻易改换方向，也不贪不妒。时机成熟时，自然会有出头之日，在众人之中大放光彩。
reading.zh-TW: 你現在時運還未通達，凡事推進較慢，不必心急。不妨像江邊垂釣的人一樣，沉住氣、守住本分，把本事收藏好，等待合適的時機。這段時間宜守不宜進，不要輕易改換方向，也不貪不妒。時機成熟時，自然會有出頭之日，在眾人之中大放光彩。
reading.en: Your fortune hasn’t opened up yet and things are moving slowly, but there is no need to be anxious. Be like the angler by the river: stay calm, keep to your place, keep your abilities in reserve and wait for the right moment. For now it is better to hold than to advance; don’t change direction lightly, and don’t give in to greed or envy. When the time is ripe, your day will come and you will shine among many.

tale.zh-CN: 姜尚字子牙，祖先受封于吕地，所以又叫吕尚、吕望。为了避开商纣的暴政，他隐居在东海之滨，后来在渭水边的磻溪垂钓。相传他的鱼钩是直的，心思并不在鱼，而在于等待能让他施展抱负的明君。周文王听说他的贤能，请他做自己的老师，民间还传说他那时已经八十岁了。后来周武王起兵伐纣，灭商兴周，尊称他为尚父，并把齐地封给了他。正如这支签说的，时运未到时不妨像江边的钓翁一样沉住气，等时机成熟，自然能在众人之中大展身手。
tale.zh-TW: 姜尚字子牙，祖先受封於呂地，所以又叫呂尚、呂望。為了避開商紂的暴政，他隱居在東海之濱，後來在渭水邊的磻溪垂釣。相傳他的魚鉤是直的，心思並不在魚，而在於等待能讓他施展抱負的明君。周文王聽說他的賢能，請他做自己的老師，民間還傳說他那時已經八十歲了。後來周武王起兵伐紂，滅商興周，尊稱他為尚父，並把齊地封給了他。正如這支籤說的，時運未到時不妨像江邊的釣翁一樣沉住氣，等時機成熟，自然能在眾人之中大展身手。
tale.en: Jiang Shang, styled Ziya, descended from ancestors enfeoffed at Lü, so he was also called Lü Shang or Lü Wang. To escape the tyranny of King Zhou of Shang, he lived in seclusion by the eastern sea and later fished at Panxi on the Wei River. Legend has it that his hook was straight: his mind was not on fish but on waiting for a wise ruler who would let him put his talents to use. King Wen of Zhou heard of his worth and made him his teacher, and folk tradition says he was already eighty by then. Later King Wu raised an army against the Shang, overthrew it and founded the Zhou, honored him as “Father Shang,” and granted him the land of Qi. As this lot says, when your time has not yet come, be as patient as the old man fishing by the river; when the moment ripens, you will stand out among thousands.

career.zh-CN: 时机未到，宜守住现状、积蓄实力，等待合适的时机再出手。
career.zh-TW: 時機未到，宜守住現狀、積蓄實力，等待合適的時機再出手。
career.en: The time isn’t right yet; hold your position, build your strength, and act when the moment comes.

wealth.zh-CN: 努力经营、诚信不欺，财路会慢慢打开，但不可勉强。
wealth.zh-TW: 努力經營、誠信不欺，財路會慢慢開啟，但不可勉強。
wealth.en: Work hard and deal honestly, and money will gradually open up, but don’t force it.

love.zh-CN: 感情不宜勉强牵合，多从长远考虑，理智对待。
love.zh-TW: 感情不宜勉強牽合，多從長遠考慮，理智對待。
love.en: Don’t force a match; think about the long term and approach it with a clear head.

travel.zh-CN: 现在不是出行的好时候，暂缓一阵，等局面安定再走。
travel.zh-TW: 現在不是出行的好時候，暫緩一陣，等局面安定再走。
travel.en: This isn’t a good time to travel; wait a while until things settle down.

exam.zh-CN: 如铁杵磨针，坚持用功，得志可期。
exam.zh-TW: 如鐵杵磨針，堅持用功，得志可期。
exam.en: Like grinding an iron rod into a needle, keep at your studies and success will come.

lost.zh-CN: 失物不易找寻，借此反省，今后多加小心。
lost.zh-TW: 失物不易找尋，藉此反省，今後多加小心。
lost.en: The item is hard to find; take it as a lesson and be more careful from now on.

health.zh-CN: 宜平心静气、规律作息，旧有不适要及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 宜平心靜氣、規律作息，舊有不適要及時就醫。
health.en: Keep calm and keep regular hours; if old complaints flare up, see a doctor promptly.

shengyi: 時未亨。宜守舊。遇卯日。名利就。
病遲癒。守終利。行人歸。事緩濟。
dongpo: 命運當蹇。凡事遲疑。且宜守舊。藏器待時。
年與日月。逢卯則宜。或遇望日。方稱所為。
bixian: 孕男婚不成。守舊莫紛更。
不貪與不妒。平安福祿生。
jieyue: 此籤。君子占有五年之厄。庶人占有五年之難。
若能守己。轉禍為福。不宜進圖更改。休問訟。免是非也。
shiyi: 江頭釣翁。指呂望。未遇時。釣於渭濱。
及西伯侯車之載。則萬人上英雄矣。
今君指卜者說。未亨通。言目下未遇。有五年之厄。
是自庚至甲也。若能守己。待時至。卯年月。則轉禍為福。
士人高擢。庶人發福。且不但卯年月日遂意。
若望日。則玉兔重生亦應。

reading.zh-CN: 一开始满心欢喜，以为事情很顺，后来才发现远比想象复杂，先喜后忧。人情有冷有暖，世事多有反复，不必过于惊讶，经历过才懂得路不好走。这段时间凡事宜自己用心周旋，不要过度依赖他人的承诺，也不要放纵自己。放慢脚步、看清人心，兢兢业业守住本分，才能避免日后懊悔。
reading.zh-TW: 一開始滿心歡喜，以為事情很順，後來才發現遠比想像複雜，先喜後憂。人情有冷有暖，世事多有反覆，不必過於驚訝，經歷過才懂得路不好走。這段時間凡事宜自己用心周旋，不要過度依賴他人的承諾，也不要放縱自己。放慢腳步、看清人心，兢兢業業守住本分，才能避免日後懊悔。
reading.en: At first you were full of joy and thought everything would go smoothly, only to find it far more complicated than you imagined: happiness first, worry after. People’s warmth comes and goes and the world is full of reversals, so don’t be too surprised; only by walking the road do we learn how hard it is. For now, handle things yourself with care, don’t lean too much on others’ promises, and don’t let yourself go. Slow down, see people clearly, and keep diligently to your own path, and you will spare yourself regret later.

tale.zh-CN: 据戏曲《胭脂记》，宋代书生郭华前往汴京赶考，爱上了胭脂铺的女儿王月英，迷恋她的美貌，落第后也不肯回乡，一直留在汴京。两人约好日期私下相会。到了那天，王月英如约而来，郭华却喝得酩酊大醉，怎么推也推不醒。王月英只好解下自己的一只绣鞋，放进他怀中，独自回去了。郭华醒来看见怀中的绣鞋，才知错过了约会，悔恨不已。这个故事提醒人们，莫因一时迷恋而误了正事。正如这支签说的，人情冷暖、世路艰难，凡事看清再行，守住自己才是良策。
tale.zh-TW: 據戲曲《胭脂記》，宋代書生郭華前往汴京趕考，愛上了胭脂鋪的女兒王月英，迷戀她的美貌，落第後也不肯回鄉，一直留在汴京。兩人約好日期私下相會。到了那天，王月英如約而來，郭華卻喝得酩酊大醉，怎麼推也推不醒。王月英只好解下自己的一隻繡鞋，放進他懷中，獨自回去了。郭華醒來看見懷中的繡鞋，才知錯過了約會，悔恨不已。這個故事提醒人們，莫因一時迷戀而誤了正事。正如這支籤說的，人情冷暖、世路艱難，凡事看清再行，守住自己才是良策。
tale.en: According to the opera The Rouge Story, Guo Hua, a Song-dynasty scholar, traveled to Bianjing for the imperial examinations and fell for Wang Yueying, the beautiful daughter of a rouge-shop owner. Even after failing the exam he would not go home and lingered in the capital. The two arranged a secret meeting. When the day came, Wang Yueying arrived as promised, but Guo Hua was so drunk that no amount of shaking would wake him. She slipped off one of her embroidered shoes, tucked it into his robe and went home alone. When Guo Hua awoke and found the shoe, he realized he had missed their meeting and was overcome with remorse. The tale warns against letting a passing infatuation derail what matters. As this lot says, people’s warmth can cool and the road of life is hard; look carefully before you go, and holding to your own path is the wisest plan.

career.zh-CN: 开头容易后面难，宜步步谨慎，亲力亲为，不要轻信他人承诺。
career.zh-TW: 開頭容易後面難，宜步步謹慎，親力親為，不要輕信他人承諾。
career.en: Easy to start, hard to finish; take each step carefully, do the work yourself, and don’t rely on others’ promises.

wealth.zh-CN: 财气偏弱，不宜强求，保住日常所需就好。
wealth.zh-TW: 財氣偏弱，不宜強求，保住日常所需就好。
wealth.en: Money luck is weak; don’t force it, and be content to cover your daily needs.

love.zh-CN: 一时心动不必急着定下，相处久了才见性情，冷静观察再说。
love.zh-TW: 一時心動不必急著定下，相處久了才見性情，冷靜觀察再說。
love.en: Don’t rush to commit over a sudden spark; true character shows over time, so watch calmly first.

travel.zh-CN: 出外打拼费时费力，此时不如留在熟悉的地方。
travel.zh-TW: 出外打拼費時費力，此時不如留在熟悉的地方。
travel.en: Striking out far from home is costly in time and effort; better to stay where you know for now.

exam.zh-CN: 名利得失不必看得太重，专心学习、避免分心更重要。
exam.zh-TW: 名利得失不必看得太重，專心學習、避免分心更重要。
exam.en: Don’t take success or failure too hard; staying focused and avoiding distractions matters more.

lost.zh-CN: 失物难以追回，不必再花心力，适时放下。
lost.zh-TW: 失物難以追回，不必再花心力，適時放下。
lost.en: The item is unlikely to come back; don’t spend more energy on it, and let it go.

health.zh-CN: 平时注意保养，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 平時注意保養，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Look after yourself day to day, keep regular hours, and see a doctor promptly if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 始雖易。終則難。名利失。病未安。
訟反覆。孕生女。行未歸。事多阻。
dongpo: 事望團圓。反生齟齬。人多不情。恐難憑據。
只宜自省。無為他誤。戒之戒之。且疑且慮。
bixian: 乍喜反成憂。虛花總不收。
世情多反覆。守己是良謀。
jieyue: 此籤先喜後憂。不宜放肆。大概親而又陳。合而復離。
歷涉險阻。竟無成。尤兢兢業業。庶免後悔。
shiyi: 大抵此籤。好事難成。親中招怨。惹禍難免。婚不宜成。
占此不可托人。宜自周旋。免得後日之悔。
曰樂天諷諫。曰行路難。不在水兮不在山。人情反覆。問是也。
應字或作方字亦通。

reading.zh-CN: 两家条件看似相当，但若缘分未到，就不必勉强比较争取。眼下双方心意还未相合，容易生出口舌误会，心里话不要随便对外人说。凡事暂且等待，不要妄动，到了新春时节或时机成熟，好消息自然会来。顺其自然、谨言慎行，缘分自会显现。
reading.zh-TW: 兩家條件看似相當，但若緣分未到，就不必勉強比較爭取。眼下雙方心意還未相合，容易生出口舌誤會，心裡話不要隨便對外人說。凡事暫且等待，不要妄動，到了新春時節或時機成熟，好訊息自然會來。順其自然、謹言慎行，緣分自會顯現。
reading.en: The two sides may seem evenly matched, but if the bond isn’t meant to be yet, there is no need to compete or push for it. Right now your hearts aren’t aligned and misunderstandings arise easily, so keep your private thoughts from those who aren’t close friends. Wait for now and don’t act rashly; when the new spring comes or the time is ripe, good news will arrive on its own. Let things take their course, mind your words, and the right bond will reveal itself.

tale.zh-CN: 据《西厢记》，唐代书生张珙，字君瑞，因事来到蒲东，借住在普救寺。寺的西厢住着崔家母女，女儿崔莺莺容貌绝美。不久乱兵围住寺院，崔夫人许诺，谁能保全全家，就把莺莺许配给他。张生设法写信请来朋友带兵解围，崔家这才转危为安。谁知崔夫人事后反悔，只让两人以兄妹相称，张生因思念莺莺而病倒。剧中后来张生进京应考，高中归来，两人终成眷属。正如这支签说的，门户相当也要看缘分，不必强求较量，等春风送来好消息，自然琴瑟和鸣。
tale.zh-TW: 據《西廂記》，唐代書生張珙，字君瑞，因事來到蒲東，借住在普救寺。寺的西廂住著崔家母女，女兒崔鶯鶯容貌絕美。不久亂兵圍住寺院，崔夫人許諾，誰能保全全家，就把鶯鶯許配給他。張生設法寫信請來朋友帶兵解圍，崔家這才轉危為安。誰知崔夫人事後反悔，只讓兩人以兄妹相稱，張生因思念鶯鶯而病倒。劇中後來張生進京應考，高中歸來，兩人終成眷屬。正如這支籤說的，門戶相當也要看緣分，不必強求較量，等春風送來好訊息，自然琴瑟和鳴。
tale.en: According to The Romance of the Western Chamber, the Tang scholar Zhang Gong, styled Junrui, traveled to Pudong and lodged at Pujiu Temple. In the temple’s west wing lived Madam Cui and her daughter Yingying, a young woman of rare beauty. Soon rebel soldiers surrounded the temple, and Madam Cui promised Yingying’s hand to whoever could save the family. Zhang wrote to a friend, who brought troops to lift the siege. Afterward, however, Madam Cui went back on her word and had the two treat each other only as brother and sister, and Zhang fell ill with longing. Later in the play, Zhang goes to the capital for the examinations, returns with honors, and the two are finally wed. As this lot says, even a well-matched pair needs true affinity; don’t force it, and when the spring breeze brings good news, harmony will follow.

career.zh-CN: 名利来得稍迟，继续奋发努力，待时机成熟再求突破。
career.zh-TW: 名利來得稍遲，繼續奮發努力，待時機成熟再求突破。
career.en: Recognition is slow to come; keep pushing yourself and aim for a breakthrough when the time is right.

wealth.zh-CN: 勤奋经营值得肯定，但不宜勉强；与人合作约定清楚，财路更通。
wealth.zh-TW: 勤奮經營值得肯定，但不宜勉強；與人合作約定清楚，財路更通。
wealth.en: Your hard work is commendable, but don’t overreach; clear agreements with partners will open the way to money.

love.zh-CN: 门当户对也要看缘分，不必强求，静待时机水到渠成。
love.zh-TW: 門當戶對也要看緣分，不必強求，靜待時機水到渠成。
love.en: Even a good match on paper needs real affinity; don’t force it, and let it come together in time.

travel.zh-CN: 守在原地比外出更稳妥，不必急于远行。
travel.zh-TW: 守在原地比外出更穩妥，不必急於遠行。
travel.en: Staying put is safer than heading out; there is no need to rush a long trip.

exam.zh-CN: 像炼铁成钢一样，再坚持一段时间，功名可期。
exam.zh-TW: 像煉鐵成鋼一樣，再堅持一段時間，功名可期。
exam.en: As iron becomes steel through tempering, keep going a while longer and success can be expected.

lost.zh-CN: 失物或许只能找回一部分，权当教训，今后小心。
lost.zh-TW: 失物或許只能找回一部分，權當教訓，今後小心。
lost.en: You may get only part of it back; take it as a lesson and be careful from now on.

health.zh-CN: 注意休息、起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 注意休息、起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Get enough rest, keep regular hours, and see a doctor promptly if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 婚未合。訟未決。名利遲。音信缺。
孕難生。防口舌。非知己。莫妄說。
dongpo: 兩意未合。宜於待時。防憂與慮。謹慎愆非。
直待來春。萬事方吉。若或妄動。徒勞心懷。
bixian: 兩家未合。百事難諧。
門戶可慮。猷恐成乖。
jieyue: 此籤名不成。利不就。婚不合。
凡事卻待新春。方始稱意。若妄作。反勞心力。終不能如人心願也。
shiyi: 各相當者。謂情不能諧也。主骨肉有言語口舌之傷矣。
其物換人移。方得。妻子和合。父母克諧。
若或妄為。徒勞無益。直遇寅卯辰年月日。名利皆有。百事合宜也。

reading.zh-CN: 纠纷拖得很久，一时难以说清，与其争个高下，不如暂且放下，回到日常生活。这段时间名利都不必强求，凡有谋划，都要等待时机成熟。旁人的挑拨煽动千万不要轻信，以免平地起风波。遇到难以决断的事，最好和至亲之人商量，以和为贵，自会有人伸手相助。
reading.zh-TW: 糾紛拖得很久，一時難以說清，與其爭個高下，不如暫且放下，回到日常生活。這段時間名利都不必強求，凡有謀劃，都要等待時機成熟。旁人的挑撥煽動千萬不要輕信，以免平地起風波。遇到難以決斷的事，最好和至親之人商量，以和為貴，自會有人伸手相助。
reading.en: This dispute has dragged on and can’t easily be settled; rather than fighting to win, set it aside for now and return to everyday life. Don’t push for fame or gain in this period, and let any plans wait until the time is ripe. Never believe those who try to stir you up, or a calm situation may turn stormy. When you face a hard decision, talk it over with those closest to you; put harmony first, and someone will reach out to help.

tale.zh-CN: 据《晋书》，王祥字休征，琅邪临沂人，生性极孝。他早年丧母，继母朱氏待他不好，常在父亲面前说他坏话，他却对继母越发恭谨。有一年天寒地冻，继母想吃鲜鱼，王祥脱下衣服准备凿冰捕鱼，冰面忽然自己裂开，两条鲤鱼跃了出来，他便捧回家奉给继母。后世把这件事传为“卧冰求鲤”。他的异母弟王览从小就常护着哥哥。王祥后来官至太保，进封公爵。正如这支签说的，纷争难以辨明时不如先放下，别听旁人挑拨，遇事多与至亲之人商量。
tale.zh-TW: 據《晉書》，王祥字休徵，琅邪臨沂人，生性極孝。他早年喪母，繼母朱氏待他不好，常在父親面前說他壞話，他卻對繼母越發恭謹。有一年天寒地凍，繼母想吃鮮魚，王祥脫下衣服準備鑿冰捕魚，冰面忽然自己裂開，兩條鯉魚躍了出來，他便捧回家奉給繼母。後世把這件事傳為“臥冰求鯉”。他的異母弟王覽從小就常護著哥哥。王祥後來官至太保，進封公爵。正如這支籤說的，紛爭難以辨明時不如先放下，別聽旁人挑撥，遇事多與至親之人商量。
tale.en: According to the Book of Jin, Wang Xiang, styled Xiuzheng, of Linyi in Langya, was devoted to his parents by nature. He lost his mother early, and his stepmother, Lady Zhu, treated him unkindly and often spoke ill of him to his father, yet he only grew more respectful toward her. One bitterly cold winter she longed for fresh fish, so Wang Xiang took off his clothes, ready to break through the ice; the ice suddenly cracked open on its own and two carp leapt out, which he carried home to her. Later generations remembered this as “lying on the ice for carp.” His younger half-brother, Wang Lan, often shielded him from the time they were small. Wang Xiang rose to become Grand Guardian and was made a duke. As this lot says, when a dispute can’t be sorted out, set it down for now; don’t heed those who stir things up, and talk matters over with your own family.

career.zh-CN: 眼下进展不顺，可考虑调整方向，凡事与亲近的人商量后再定。
career.zh-TW: 眼下進展不順，可考慮調整方向，凡事與親近的人商量後再定。
career.en: Progress is stalled; consider a change of direction, and talk with people close to you before deciding.

wealth.zh-CN: 不宜贪求急利，不慌不忙、步步为营才稳妥。
wealth.zh-TW: 不宜貪求急利，不慌不忙、步步為營才穩妥。
wealth.en: Don’t chase quick profits; an unhurried, step-by-step approach is the safe one.

love.zh-CN: 双方心意不合时不必强凑，日久自会看清。
love.zh-TW: 雙方心意不合時不必強湊，日久自會看清。
love.en: If your hearts don’t match, don’t force it; time will make things clear.

travel.zh-CN: 出行不如守在原地，远方的人则会到来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行不如守在原地，遠方的人則會到來。
travel.en: Better to stay put than to travel, though someone from afar will come to you.

exam.zh-CN: 一时未能如愿，不妨调整学习方向，等待时机。
exam.zh-TW: 一時未能如願，不妨調整學習方向，等待時機。
exam.en: If things don’t go your way this time, adjust your approach to study and wait for your chance.

lost.zh-CN: 失物难以寻回，不必费心，重新添置即可。
lost.zh-TW: 失物難以尋回，不必費心，重新添置即可。
lost.en: The item is unlikely to be found; don’t fret, simply replace it.

health.zh-CN: 不要自己乱用偏方，作息规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 不要自己亂用偏方，作息規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Don’t try to treat yourself with home remedies; keep regular hours and see a doctor if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 訟難明。和為貴。名利無。行人至。
婚未成。病有祟。財莫貪。終無利。
dongpo: 訟事未決。且宜從和。傍人煽惑。平地風波。
慎勿輕信。自投網羅。謀之兄弟。誰能奈何。
bixian: 埋頭莫向前。時違休怨天。
貴人垂手援。亨通到百年。
jieyue: 此籤訟事未辨。以和為貴。名利全無。婚姻未當。
凡有謀望。且待時來。有人煽惑。勿輕信也。
shiyi: 問訟顯然宜和。士人占之。功名未遂。
官員占之。主難進步。有礙前程。
蓋明有神非。幽有鬼責。財利難求。營謀寡效。
凡事待時。不宜聽信讒人。萋菲之說。
兄弟謂至親之人。當謀之以決疑惑也。

reading.zh-CN: 田产钱财之类的事，最好坐下来心平气和地协商，各让一步。一旦闹到公开对立，双方都会受伤；即使靠手段一时占了上风，也可能给家人和后代留下隐患。这段时间凡事依本分而行，名利顺其自然，不要算计他人，也不要谋取不属于自己的东西。守住平常心，循理而行，就能保住平安。
reading.zh-TW: 田產錢財之類的事，最好坐下來心平氣和地協商，各讓一步。一旦鬧到公開對立，雙方都會受傷；即使靠手段一時佔了上風，也可能給家人和後代留下隱患。這段時間凡事依本分而行，名利順其自然，不要算計他人，也不要謀取不屬於自己的東西。守住平常心，循理而行，就能保住平安。
reading.en: Matters of land and money are best settled by sitting down calmly and each side giving a little. Once things turn into open confrontation, both sides get hurt, and even if you gain the upper hand through cleverness, you may leave trouble for your family and those who come after. For now, act within your proper bounds, let fame and gain come as they will, don’t scheme against others, and don’t reach for what isn’t yours. Keep an even mind and follow what is right, and you will stay safe and sound.

tale.zh-CN: 据《晋书》，石崇字季伦，西晋时出任城阳太守，因参与伐吴有功，被封为安阳乡侯。他家财丰厚，宅第宏伟华丽，饮食尽是山珍海味，还和外戚王恺比赛谁更奢侈。他有一位美丽的歌伎名叫绿珠，相传是他花重金买来的，安置在金谷园中。后来赵王司马伦掌权，他的亲信孙秀派人索要绿珠，石崇不肯给。孙秀便劝赵王伦以罪名诛杀石崇，绿珠也在石崇被捕时坠楼而死。正如这支签说的，财物之争最好心平气和地商量，靠机关算计争来的东西，往往会留下祸根。
tale.zh-TW: 據《晉書》，石崇字季倫，西晉時出任城陽太守，因參與伐吳有功，被封為安陽鄉侯。他家財豐厚，宅第宏偉華麗，飲食盡是山珍海味，還和外戚王愷比賽誰更奢侈。他有一位美麗的歌伎名叫綠珠，相傳是他花重金買來的，安置在金谷園中。後來趙王司馬倫掌權，他的親信孫秀派人索要綠珠，石崇不肯給。孫秀便勸趙王倫以罪名誅殺石崇，綠珠也在石崇被捕時墜樓而死。正如這支籤說的，財物之爭最好心平氣和地商量，靠機關算計爭來的東西，往往會留下禍根。
tale.en: According to the Book of Jin, Shi Chong, styled Jilun, served in the Western Jin as governor of Chengyang and was made a marquis for his part in the conquest of Wu. His wealth was immense, his mansions grand, his table laden with every delicacy of land and sea, and he competed with the imperial in-law Wang Kai to see who could live more lavishly. He had a beautiful singer named Lüzhu, said to have been bought at great cost, whom he kept at his Golden Valley Garden. Later, when Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, seized power, the prince’s favorite Sun Xiu sent to demand Lüzhu, and Shi Chong refused. Sun Xiu then urged the prince to have Shi Chong executed on a pretext, and as he was being arrested, Lüzhu threw herself from a tower and died. As this lot says, quarrels over property are best settled by calm talk; what is won through scheming often plants trouble for later.

career.zh-CN: 名利一时未到，宜守本分、循理行事，不要用心机去争。
career.zh-TW: 名利一時未到，宜守本分、循理行事，不要用心機去爭。
career.en: Recognition hasn’t arrived yet; do your part, act fairly, and don’t scheme to get ahead.

wealth.zh-CN: 暂且守住现有的财产，不打非分之想，财务往来要公平清楚。
wealth.zh-TW: 暫且守住現有的財產，不打非分之想，財務往來要公平清楚。
wealth.en: Hold on to what you have, don’t covet what isn’t yours, and keep all money dealings fair and clear.

love.zh-CN: 若双方实在合不来，不必勉强维系，好聚好散。
love.zh-TW: 若雙方實在合不來，不必勉強維繫，好聚好散。
love.en: If you truly aren’t compatible, don’t force it to continue; part on good terms.

travel.zh-CN: 路途多有阻碍，留在家中更安心。
travel.zh-TW: 路途多有阻礙，留在家中更安心。
travel.en: The road has many obstacles; staying home will bring more peace of mind.

exam.zh-CN: 功名暂时受阻，按部就班用功，不必心急。
exam.zh-TW: 功名暫時受阻，按部就班用功，不必心急。
exam.en: Progress is held up for now; keep studying step by step without rushing.

lost.zh-CN: 失物不易找回，不必执着，重新添置即可。
lost.zh-TW: 失物不易找回，不必執著，重新添置即可。
lost.en: The item is hard to recover; don’t dwell on it, simply replace it.

health.zh-CN: 旧有不适要重视，及时就医调理，起居规律。
health.zh-TW: 舊有不適要重視，及時就醫調理，起居規律。
health.en: Take old ailments seriously, see a doctor in good time, and keep regular hours.

shengyi: 事悖理。訟必傷。名利未。亦如常。
行人阻。病宜禳。且謹慎。保安康。
dongpo: 事依本分。自有前程。若用機關。反害其身。
如作交易。當合人情。倘或妄作。難保安寧。
bixian: 交加二字必虛勤。若問財時必見侵。
凡事只宜退一步。須知守己得安寧。
jieyue: 此籤切須依本分。自有前程。如有機關。反成害己利人。
凡謀望。自家商酌方好。名利未遂。宜守平常。
行人有阻。病可禳。婚難成。謹保安康。
shiyi: 此言訟不成。凡事循理而行。不願乎外。自得亨利。
子孫殃者。本身無事。家口多難。
占此。謀望。參商。功名阻滯。
切宜自安本分。莫置度外。恐有彼此是非。

reading.zh-CN: 你心中盘算的事，可能只是镜花水月，茫茫然看不到边际。与其空想或急于求成，不如放慢脚步，脚踏实地做好眼前的每一件事。名利一时难得，强求反而有损，但只要一心向善、循着正道走，终会有所收获。行善自有善报，这个道理从来不会错。
reading.zh-TW: 你心中盤算的事，可能只是鏡花水月，茫茫然看不到邊際。與其空想或急於求成，不如放慢腳步，腳踏實地做好眼前的每一件事。名利一時難得，強求反而有損，但只要一心向善、循著正道走，終會有所收穫。行善自有善報，這個道理從來不會錯。
reading.en: What you are planning may be no more than flowers in a mirror or the moon in water, vague and without end in sight. Rather than daydreaming or rushing for results, slow down and do each task in front of you with your feet firmly on the ground. Fame and gain are hard to come by for now, and forcing them only does harm, but if you keep to goodness and walk the right path, you will reap something in the end. Good deeds bring good returns; that has never failed.

tale.zh-CN: 据《史记》，孟尝君名田文，是齐国宗室田婴的儿子。他曾劝父亲说，家里积累了万金财富，门下却看不到一位贤能之士。田婴去世后，田文继承了薛地的封爵，这就是孟尝君。他在薛地广招各国宾客，连逃亡在外、犯过罪的人也来投奔。孟尝君不惜舍弃家业，优厚地款待他们，天下士人因此纷纷归附，门下食客多达数千人，他对待宾客不分贵贱，一律与自己同等。后来他在秦国遇险，正是靠会学鸡叫、会偷东西的门客才得以脱身。正如这支签说的，与其空想，不如脚踏实地，善待他人，善有善报。
tale.zh-TW: 據《史記》，孟嘗君名田文，是齊國宗室田嬰的兒子。他曾勸父親說，家裡積累了萬金財富，門下卻看不到一位賢能之士。田嬰去世後，田文繼承了薛地的封爵，這就是孟嘗君。他在薛地廣招各國賓客，連逃亡在外、犯過罪的人也來投奔。孟嘗君不惜捨棄家業，優厚地款待他們，天下士人因此紛紛歸附，門下食客多達數千人，他對待賓客不分貴賤，一律與自己同等。後來他在秦國遇險，正是靠會學雞叫、會偷東西的門客才得以脫身。正如這支籤說的，與其空想，不如腳踏實地，善待他人，善有善報。
tale.en: According to the Records of the Grand Historian, Lord Mengchang was Tian Wen, son of Tian Ying, a prince of the royal house of Qi. He once pointed out to his father that their family had piled up a vast fortune, yet not one worthy man could be found among their followers. When Tian Ying died, Tian Wen inherited the fief of Xue and became Lord Mengchang. There he welcomed guests from every state, even fugitives and men who had broken the law. He gave freely of his own estate to treat them generously, so that men of talent from all over the realm flocked to him, and he came to feed several thousand retainers, treating each as his equal regardless of rank. Later, when he was in danger in Qin, it was retainers who could crow like a rooster and steal like a dog who got him out. As this lot says, rather than chasing empty dreams, keep your feet on solid ground; treat others well, and good will come back to you.

career.zh-CN: 名利来得不易，但踏实努力，终会有所成。
career.zh-TW: 名利來得不易，但踏實努力，終會有所成。
career.en: Success doesn’t come easily, but steady, grounded effort will get you there in the end.

wealth.zh-CN: 平稳踏实必有收获，切忌贪心冒进。
wealth.zh-TW: 平穩踏實必有收穫，切忌貪心冒進。
wealth.en: A steady, practical approach will bring returns; avoid greed and reckless moves.

love.zh-CN: 日久见人心，细心观察对方的言行，再定终身不迟。
love.zh-TW: 日久見人心，細心觀察對方的言行，再定終身不遲。
love.en: Time reveals the heart; watch the other person’s words and actions carefully before making a lifelong commitment.

travel.zh-CN: 眼下不宜远行，在外的人也会晚些归来。
travel.zh-TW: 眼下不宜遠行，在外的人也會晚些歸來。
travel.en: Now is not a good time for long trips, and those away may be late returning.

exam.zh-CN: 天资平常也不要紧，有心勤学，照样能取得好成绩。
exam.zh-TW: 天資平常也不要緊，有心勤學，照樣能取得好成績。
exam.en: Ordinary talent is no barrier; study diligently and you can still do very well.

lost.zh-CN: 可往西南方向找找看，或许会有收获。
lost.zh-TW: 可往西南方向找找看，或許會有收穫。
lost.en: Try looking toward the southwest; you may find it there.

health.zh-CN: 看病要选可靠的医院和医生，起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 看病要選可靠的醫院和醫生，起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: Choose a reliable clinic and doctor, keep regular hours, and get checked promptly if you feel unwell.

shengyi: 名利難。終則有。病禱神。訟勿鬥。
行人遲。事難就。且向善。祈福佑。
dongpo: 作事未成。空自指擬。且宜緩圖。急則損己。
更宜向善。禱神求安。轉禍為福。可免多端。
bixian: 本分兩字到處諧。虧為妄想便生災。
財源未遂徒勞力。且宜向善保亨來。
jieyue: 此籤不宜妄意求謀。無事空自指擬。定必有損。
切宜向善。祈禱神靈。轉禍成福。
事有多般。功名無。訟勿鬥。行人遲。財難就。
向善保安。乃為上策。
shiyi: 空華謂事無成也。未有涯亦空也。凡事宜緩。不宜妄動。
求名利者。難得易失。若從善事行去。則是腳踏實地。無失處。
善為善應。言天之報施。並無差謬。
如遇禍患。占此能修省向善。自然轉凶為吉。而天必佑之矣。

reading.zh-CN: 过去一直怀才不遇，时机总是差那么一点，今年运势终于转好。想做的事、想求的事大多能够如意，买卖经营、求名求利都少有阻滞。感情婚姻也和顺美满，彼此相合。把握这段好时光，同时懂得积蓄与珍惜，福气才能延续下去。
reading.zh-TW: 過去一直懷才不遇，時機總是差那麼一點，今年運勢終於轉好。想做的事、想求的事大多能夠如意，買賣經營、求名求利都少有阻滯。感情婚姻也和順美滿，彼此相合。把握這段好時光，同時懂得積蓄與珍惜，福氣才能延續下去。
reading.en: Until now your talents have gone unrecognized and the timing always seemed a little off, but this year your luck has finally turned. Most of what you hope and work for can go your way, and business, reputation and income will meet few obstacles. Love and marriage are harmonious and well matched too. Make the most of this good season, and remember to save and to treasure what you have, so the good fortune carries on.

tale.zh-CN: 据戏曲《白兔记》等民间故事，五代时沙陀人刘知远早年贫寒，在节度使岳彦真手下当军校，岳彦真看他相貌不凡，便把女儿嫁给了他。史书则记载，刘知远后来在后晋做官，出任北京留守、河东节度使，镇守太原。契丹攻灭后晋，中原无主，刘知远便在太原即皇帝位，国号汉，史称后汉，并且沿用后晋的天福年号，没有另改年号。正如这支签说的，从前时运未到，一旦星运相宜，营求动作都能如意，婚姻也和合美满。
tale.zh-TW: 據戲曲《白兔記》等民間故事，五代時沙陀人劉知遠早年貧寒，在節度使嶽彥真手下當軍校，嶽彥真看他相貌不凡，便把女兒嫁給了他。史書則記載，劉知遠後來在後晉做官，出任北京留守、河東節度使，鎮守太原。契丹攻滅後晉，中原無主，劉知遠便在太原即皇帝位，國號漢，史稱後漢，並且沿用後晉的天福年號，沒有另改年號。正如這支籤說的，從前時運未到，一旦星運相宜，營求動作都能如意，婚姻也和合美滿。
tale.en: According to the opera The White Rabbit and other folk tales, Liu Zhiyuan, a man of Shatuo descent in the Five Dynasties era, started out poor and served as an officer under the military governor Yue Yanzhen, who, struck by his remarkable looks, gave him his daughter in marriage. The histories record that Liu later served the Later Jin as regent of the Northern Capital and military governor of Hedong, guarding Taiyuan. When the Khitans destroyed the Later Jin and the central plains were left without a ruler, Liu took the throne at Taiyuan and named his state Han, known to history as the Later Han, keeping the Later Jin’s Tianfu era name rather than proclaiming a new one. As this lot says, your time had not yet come, but now the stars are aligned; what you seek and set out to do will go well, and marriage will be happy and harmonious.

career.zh-CN: 久困之后时来运转，做事顺利，宜把握机会、积极进取。
career.zh-TW: 久困之後時來運轉，做事順利，宜把握機會、積極進取。
career.en: After a long wait your luck turns; things go well, so seize the chance and push forward.

wealth.zh-CN: 有眼光、敢谋划，财运亨通，收获可观，得意时也要懂得守成。
wealth.zh-TW: 有眼光、敢謀劃，財運亨通，收穫可觀，得意時也要懂得守成。
wealth.en: With vision and good planning, money flows and the gains are good; even so, protect what you earn.

love.zh-CN: 两情相合，婚姻美满，珍惜彼此可白头偕老。
love.zh-TW: 兩情相合，婚姻美滿，珍惜彼此可白頭偕老。
love.en: You are well matched and the marriage is happy; cherish each other and you can grow old together.

travel.zh-CN: 出行可以成行，途中多加小心；盼望的人也会到来。
travel.zh-TW: 出行可以成行，途中多加小心；盼望的人也會到來。
travel.en: Trips can go ahead, just take care on the way; the one you are waiting for will also arrive.

exam.zh-CN: 多年苦读终有回报，考试名次可期。
exam.zh-TW: 多年苦讀終有回報，考試名次可期。
exam.en: Years of hard study will pay off, and a good result can be expected.

lost.zh-CN: 可往西北方向寻找，耐心等待，会有线索。
lost.zh-TW: 可往西北方向尋找，耐心等待，會有線索。
lost.en: Look toward the northwest and be patient; a clue will turn up.

health.zh-CN: 宜规律作息，有不适及时找好医生诊治，安心调养。
health.zh-TW: 宜規律作息，有不適及時找好醫生診治，安心調養。
health.en: Keep regular habits; if you feel unwell, see a good doctor promptly and rest with an easy mind.

shengyi: 作事吉。名利遂。婚姻成。訟得理。
孕生貴。行人至。病易安。皆吉利。
dongpo: 久困沉埋。時運今泰。作事有成。名利俱快。
更無阻滯。宜為買賣。士人占之。前程遠大。
bixian: 時來時去有其時。但要平心任所為。
自此謀為皆遂意。孕生貴子時宗枝。
jieyue: 此籤不問貴賤。皆有和合之象。謀為各事。從今以後可成就也。
shiyi: 作客經紀吉。營與人索取吉。求要為此事吉。動力為此事吉。(吉本作曰)
作凡事。交秋來新運。自然無阻。無子者得子。無官者得官。
始雖頗相宜。終則滔滔順也。
從來未得時。有兩義。占者在得意之日。反不應。此在失意之日。許應此。
又當推年命歲運相合。詩意為美。

reading.zh-CN: 满腹心事无人可诉，好像只能对着流水倾吐，眼前的路也多有险阻、反复不定。这支签提醒你，世事如流水匆匆而去，名利富贵也像浮云一样难以长留，不必执着强求。此时宜放缓脚步、退一步反省，凡事随顺时势，谨慎守住现有的一切。看淡得失、照顾好内心，反而能走得安稳。
reading.zh-TW: 滿腹心事無人可訴，好像只能對著流水傾吐，眼前的路也多有險阻、反覆不定。這支籤提醒你，世事如流水匆匆而去，名利富貴也像浮雲一樣難以長留，不必執著強求。此時宜放緩腳步、退一步反省，凡事隨順時勢，謹慎守住現有的一切。看淡得失、照顧好內心，反而能走得安穩。
reading.en: Your heart is full of things you can tell no one, as if you could only confide in the flowing water, and the road ahead is rough and uncertain. This lot reminds you that the affairs of the world rush past like a stream, and fame and fortune drift like clouds that never stay, so there is no need to cling to them. For now, slow down, step back and reflect, go along with the times, and carefully protect what you already have. Hold gains and losses lightly and look after your inner self, and you will walk on more steadily.

tale.zh-CN: 据《后汉书》，严光字子陵，会稽余姚人，年少时就很有名声，曾与刘秀一同游学。刘秀即位成为汉光武帝后，严光改名换姓，隐居起来。光武帝思念他的贤能，派人按他的相貌四处寻访。后来齐国上报说，有一名男子披着羊皮衣在水泽中垂钓。光武帝怀疑就是严光，便备车派使者去聘请，往返三次他才肯来。光武帝任命他为谏议大夫，他不肯接受，回到富春山耕种隐居，后人把他垂钓的地方称为严陵濑。正如这支签说的，世事如流水，功名富贵如浮云，看淡得失，心自安然。
tale.zh-TW: 據《後漢書》，嚴光字子陵，會稽餘姚人，年少時就很有名聲，曾與劉秀一同遊學。劉秀即位成為漢光武帝后，嚴光改名換姓，隱居起來。光武帝思念他的賢能，派人按他的相貌四處尋訪。後來齊國上報說，有一名男子披著羊皮衣在水澤中垂釣。光武帝懷疑就是嚴光，便備車派使者去聘請，往返三次他才肯來。光武帝任命他為諫議大夫，他不肯接受，回到富春山耕種隱居，後人把他垂釣的地方稱為嚴陵瀨。正如這支籤說的，世事如流水，功名富貴如浮雲，看淡得失，心自安然。
tale.en: According to the Book of the Later Han, Yan Guang, styled Ziling, of Yuyao in Kuaiji, was well known from a young age and had studied alongside Liu Xiu. When Liu Xiu took the throne as Emperor Guangwu of Han, Yan Guang changed his name and went into hiding. Missing his wise old friend, the emperor had people search for him by his description. Eventually the state of Qi reported a man in a sheepskin coat fishing in a marsh. Suspecting it was Yan Guang, the emperor sent envoys with a carriage to invite him, and only after three trips did he agree to come. Offered a post as Grand Remonstrator, he declined and went back to farm at Mount Fuchun, and later generations named the spot where he fished the Yanling Rapids. As this lot says, the affairs of the world flow away like water and wealth and fame drift like clouds; hold gains and losses lightly, and your heart will be at peace.

career.zh-CN: 功名一时难成，不妨放下执念，考虑调整方向，随顺时势。
career.zh-TW: 功名一時難成，不妨放下執念，考慮調整方向，隨順時勢。
career.en: Advancement is hard to achieve right now; let go of fixed ideas, consider a new direction, and go with the times.

wealth.zh-CN: 求财要走正道，不义之财不可取，稳守为上。
wealth.zh-TW: 求財要走正道，不義之財不可取，穩守為上。
wealth.en: Earn money by honest means, never take what isn’t rightly yours, and focus on holding steady.

love.zh-CN: 婚事犹豫不定，若彼此不合，不宜强求坚持。
love.zh-TW: 婚事猶豫不定，若彼此不合，不宜強求堅持。
love.en: Marriage plans are uncertain; if you aren’t right for each other, don’t insist on holding on.

travel.zh-CN: 此行多有险阻，不如留在原地；远方的人一时难归。
travel.zh-TW: 此行多有險阻，不如留在原地；遠方的人一時難歸。
travel.en: This journey faces many hazards, so better to stay where you are; those far away may not return soon.

exam.zh-CN: 名利看淡一些，专心积累，不必为一时得失烦恼。
exam.zh-TW: 名利看淡一些，專心積累，不必為一時得失煩惱。
exam.en: Take results more lightly, focus on steady learning, and don’t be troubled by a single outcome.

lost.zh-CN: 失物难以查找，不必费心寻找，重新购置即可。
lost.zh-TW: 失物難以查詢，不必費心尋找，重新購置即可。
lost.en: The item is hard to trace; don’t spend effort searching, simply replace it.

health.zh-CN: 长期的不适不可轻视，要悉心治疗、及时就医，起居规律。
health.zh-TW: 長期的不適不可輕視，要悉心治療、及時就醫，起居規律。
health.en: Don’t ignore long-standing discomfort; get proper treatment promptly and keep regular hours.

shengyi: 訟終凶。止則宜。名利輕。病擇醫。
行人遠。婚遲疑。凡作事。且隨時。
dongpo: 凡事未決。且宜緩圖。時勢縱吉。未有神扶。
凡事退省。終保無虞。更加修福。可履亨圖。
bixian: 險人求險地。說話險心腸。
有人牢把作。凶事得安康。
jieyue: 此籤得之外履。程途險阻。終不大吉利。
訟終凶。止則吉。功名輕。行人遲。婚未成。
凡事到底不吉。宜謹守可也。
shiyi: 始雖履險地。阻中多反覆。心事向誰論者。嘆不得逢貴人之焉。
十八灘屬贛州灘名。惶恐難也。
占此。主大事已去。有包羞忍恥之累。但當修省。
功名富貴。雖得機會。終亦難就。切勿妄想。(得本作朔)
只宜謹守。凡事。照占者審之。病不可保。孕不可得。

reading.zh-CN: 这支签说的是旧日的心结：你与某人或某件事之间早有芥蒂，如今再碰到一起，也难有好结果。眼下诸事难成，不宜贪求，更不宜硬碰硬，越争越容易两败俱伤。不如退一步，放下怨气，多做好事，把心思放在照顾家人、守住家中的安稳上。时运正处低谷，步步为营，等到秋天前后，局面会慢慢转好。
reading.zh-TW: 這支籤說的是舊日的心結：你與某人或某件事之間早有芥蒂，如今再碰到一起，也難有好結果。眼下諸事難成，不宜貪求，更不宜硬碰硬，越爭越容易兩敗俱傷。不如退一步，放下怨氣，多做好事，把心思放在照顧家人、守住家中的安穩上。時運正處低谷，步步為營，等到秋天前後，局面會慢慢轉好。
reading.en: This lot speaks of an old knot: there is long-standing friction between you and someone or something, and meeting again now is unlikely to end well. Little will succeed at the moment, so do not grasp for more, and above all do not meet force with force, for the harder both sides push, the more both will lose. Step back, let go of resentment, do good where you can, and put your heart into caring for your family and keeping your home steady. Your fortunes are at a low point; move one careful step at a time, and around autumn things will slowly begin to turn.

tale.zh-CN: 战国时，齐国人孙膑和魏国人庞涓一同拜鬼谷子为师，学习兵法。孙膑的学问胜过庞涓。庞涓后来做了魏国的将军，自知才能不如孙膑，心生嫉妒，便设计陷害他，让他受了砍去双脚的刑罚。孙膑设法脱身（签书说他是装疯骗过了庞涓），回到齐国，齐威王请他做军师。后来齐国出兵攻魏，孙膑用逐日减少军灶的计策，让庞涓误以为齐军大批逃散，于是轻兵急追。追到马陵道时，齐军埋伏的弓弩一齐发射，魏军大乱，庞涓兵败身死。正如这支签所说，旧怨难解，与其针锋相对，不如多行善事、守护家人，心结才会慢慢化开。
tale.zh-TW: 戰國時，齊國人孫臏和魏國人龐涓一同拜鬼谷子為師，學習兵法。孫臏的學問勝過龐涓。龐涓後來做了魏國的將軍，自知才能不如孫臏，心生嫉妒，便設計陷害他，讓他受了砍去雙腳的刑罰。孫臏設法脫身（籤書說他是裝瘋騙過了龐涓），回到齊國，齊威王請他做軍師。後來齊國出兵攻魏，孫臏用逐日減少軍灶的計策，讓龐涓誤以為齊軍大批逃散，於是輕兵急追。追到馬陵道時，齊軍埋伏的弓弩一齊發射，魏軍大亂，龐涓兵敗身死。正如這支籤所說，舊怨難解，與其針鋒相對，不如多行善事、守護家人，心結才會慢慢化開。
tale.en: In the Warring States period, Sun Bin of Qi and Pang Juan of Wei studied the art of war together under the same master, Guiguzi. Sun Bin was the abler student. When Pang Juan became a general of Wei, he knew he could not match his old classmate, and out of jealousy he had Sun Bin framed and punished by having his feet cut off. Sun Bin managed to escape (the lot book says by feigning madness) and returned to Qi, where King Wei made him his military adviser. Later, when Qi marched against Wei, Sun Bin had his army dig fewer cooking pits each day, so Pang Juan believed the Qi troops were deserting and gave chase with only light forces. At Maling Pass, Qi crossbowmen lying in wait loosed their bolts together; the Wei army fell into chaos and Pang Juan perished in defeat. As this lot says, old grudges are hard to untie; rather than meeting hostility with hostility, do good, look after your family, and let the knot loosen with time.

career.zh-CN: 眼下谋事难成，不宜强求，先把基础打牢，等明年再作打算。
career.zh-TW: 眼下謀事難成，不宜強求，先把基礎打牢，等明年再作打算。
career.en: Plans are unlikely to come together now; do not force them, strengthen your foundations and look again next year.

wealth.zh-CN: 求财要心存善良、童叟无欺，信用立住了，才能慢慢打开局面。
wealth.zh-TW: 求財要心存善良、童叟無欺，信用立住了，才能慢慢開啟局面。
wealth.en: Seek profit with a kind heart and honest dealing; once your reputation for trust is established, things can open up.

love.zh-CN: 两人性情不太相合，不宜勉强凑合，宁可慢慢看清再说。
love.zh-TW: 兩人性情不太相合，不宜勉強湊合，寧可慢慢看清再說。
love.en: Your temperaments do not sit well together; rather than forcing a match, take time to see things clearly.

travel.zh-CN: 前路变数较多，近期不宜远行，能缓就缓，留在熟悉的地方更稳妥。
travel.zh-TW: 前路變數較多，近期不宜遠行，能緩就緩，留在熟悉的地方更穩妥。
travel.en: The road ahead is full of uncertainty; postpone long trips if you can and stay somewhere familiar.

exam.zh-CN: 这次准备的方向可能不对，结果不必强求，调整方法，来年再试。
exam.zh-TW: 這次準備的方向可能不對，結果不必強求，調整方法，來年再試。
exam.en: Your preparation may have been aimed in the wrong direction; do not fret over this result, adjust your methods and try again next year.

lost.zh-CN: 东西恐怕难以找回，不必过于执着，往后多留心收好物品。
lost.zh-TW: 東西恐怕難以找回，不必過於執著，往後多留心收好物品。
lost.en: The item is probably hard to recover; do not dwell on it, and take more care with your things from now on.

health.zh-CN: 多留意身体的老毛病，有不适及时就医，平日注意休息、起居规律。
health.zh-TW: 多留意身體的老毛病，有不適及時就醫，平日注意休息、起居規律。
health.en: Keep an eye on any long-standing complaints, see a doctor promptly if you feel unwell, and keep regular, restful habits.

shengyi: 事無成。病禱愈。出不宜。訟有理。
病有冤。求神解。若欲貪。終必敗。
dongpo: 舊有夙冤。作事隨緣。急宜向善。方保安全。
力行好事。心契上天。變凶為吉。出自福田。
bixian: 但凡謀事要心機。只怕中間有病危。
財物交加終到底。更防耗散待傷悲。
jieyue: 此籤舊有夙冤。問事無緣。訟凶。
貴人占之不吉。庶人占之不利。行人未至。謀望不成。
若問病。宜禳謝方保。財物散。不吉利也。
shiyi: 凡事雖有好機會。終於無成。諺云。無緣對面不相逢是也。
婚姻不足說。難貴顯。庶人占之。皆有變更。不可妄為。
行人望前。有歸音至。病者在望前。難過嬋娟。陰像也。
若朔日。占此。主陰人是非。謙恭以保之。勤儉以待之。則天佑之矣。
望日得之不如此。

reading.zh-CN: 这是一支上签。你的才华和品格就像清池里自然开放的白莲，不用刻意雕饰，自有光彩。眼下正是被看见、被肯定的时候，想做的事趁着好时机放手去做，不必迟疑。只是越是顺利，越要保持本色，不张扬、不骄躁，好运才能长久。
reading.zh-TW: 這是一支上籤。你的才華和品格就像清池裡自然開放的白蓮，不用刻意雕飾，自有光彩。眼下正是被看見、被肯定的時候，想做的事趁著好時機放手去做，不必遲疑。只是越是順利，越要保持本色，不張揚、不驕躁，好運才能長久。
reading.en: This is a fortunate lot. Your gifts and character are like a white lotus opening naturally in a clear pool: no need for embellishment, they shine on their own. Now is a time when you will be seen and recognized, so seize the moment and go ahead with what you hope to do, without hesitation. Only remember that the smoother things go, the more you should stay true to yourself, modest and unhurried, so that your good fortune lasts.

tale.zh-CN: 唐代大诗人李白，字太白，性情洒脱不羁，最擅长写诗。天宝初年，贺知章读了他的文章，称他是贬落人间的仙人，向唐玄宗推荐。玄宗在金銮殿召见他，与他谈论天下大事，随后让他供奉翰林。玄宗爱惜他的才华，想给他封官。可李白曾在醉中让高力士替他脱靴，高力士一向显贵，以此为耻，便在杨贵妃面前挑拨，每当玄宗要授他官职，总被贵妃阻拦。李白于是离开长安，漫游四方，把情怀寄托在诗与酒之中。他的诗却流传千古，至今人人传诵。正如这支签所说，天生的才华如池中白莲，本色自然，终究掩不住光彩。
tale.zh-TW: 唐代大詩人李白，字太白，性情灑脫不羈，最擅長寫詩。天寶初年，賀知章讀了他的文章，稱他是貶落人間的仙人，向唐玄宗推薦。玄宗在金鑾殿召見他，與他談論天下大事，隨後讓他供奉翰林。玄宗愛惜他的才華，想給他封官。可李白曾在醉中讓高力士替他脫靴，高力士一向顯貴，以此為恥，便在楊貴妃面前挑撥，每當玄宗要授他官職，總被貴妃阻攔。李白於是離開長安，漫遊四方，把情懷寄託在詩與酒之中。他的詩卻流傳千古，至今人人傳誦。正如這支籤所說，天生的才華如池中白蓮，本色自然，終究掩不住光彩。
tale.en: Li Bai, styled Taibai, the great Tang dynasty poet, was free-spirited and unconventional, and above all a gifted writer of verse. Early in the Tianbao era, the elder statesman He Zhizhang read his writing, called him an immortal banished to the human world, and recommended him to Emperor Xuanzong. The emperor received him in the Golden Bell Hall, discussed the affairs of the realm with him, and appointed him to serve in the Hanlin Academy. Xuanzong admired his talent and wished to give him an official post. But Li Bai had once, while drunk, made the powerful eunuch Gao Lishi pull off his boots. Gao never forgave the humiliation and turned Consort Yang against the poet, and each time the emperor meant to promote him, she blocked it. So Li Bai left Chang'an and wandered the land, pouring his heart into poetry and wine. His poems, however, have been recited for more than a thousand years. As this lot says, true talent is like a white lotus in a clear pool: natural and unadorned, its brightness can never be hidden.

career.zh-CN: 多年积累到了开花的时候，谋事顺利，宜趁好时机积极进取。
career.zh-TW: 多年積累到了開花的時候，謀事順利，宜趁好時機積極進取。
career.en: Years of groundwork are coming into bloom; plans go smoothly, so make the most of this good moment.

wealth.zh-CN: 财运正旺，取财有道、守住信用，可以放手一搏，但仍要细心。
wealth.zh-TW: 財運正旺，取財有道、守住信用，可以放手一搏，但仍要細心。
wealth.en: Wealth luck is strong; earn honestly and keep your word, and you can act boldly, though still with care.

love.zh-CN: 容易遇到一见倾心的人，彼此再多些了解，缘分自然水到渠成。
love.zh-TW: 容易遇到一見傾心的人，彼此再多些瞭解，緣分自然水到渠成。
love.en: You may meet someone who wins you at first sight; get to know each other a little more and things will fall into place.

travel.zh-CN: 适合出行，路上随机应变、自我约束，可平安往返。
travel.zh-TW: 適合出行，路上隨機應變、自我約束，可平安往返。
travel.en: A good time to travel; stay adaptable and self-disciplined on the road and you will return safely.

exam.zh-CN: 多年苦读将有回报，考试有望取得好成绩，之后再接再厉。
exam.zh-TW: 多年苦讀將有回報，考試有望取得好成績，之後再接再厲。
exam.en: Years of hard study are about to pay off; a good result is likely, and afterwards keep up the effort.

lost.zh-CN: 损失不大，不必苦苦追寻，往后多加留心即可。
lost.zh-TW: 損失不大，不必苦苦追尋，往後多加留心即可。
lost.en: The loss is small; no need to chase after it, just be more careful from now on.

health.zh-CN: 身心状态不错，仍要注意休息、起居规律，有不适及时就医。
health.zh-TW: 身心狀態不錯，仍要注意休息、起居規律，有不適及時就醫。
health.en: You are in good shape; still, rest well, keep regular habits, and see a doctor promptly if anything feels wrong.

shengyi: 訟決勝。名易成。病即愈。財速盈。
婚姻合。貴子生。家道泰。百事亨。
dongpo: 事易明白。不假人為。更宜出入。切莫遲疑。
士人占之。高攀桂枝。一切謀望。宜趁明時。
bixian: 更宜出入莫遲疑。士子高攀折桂枝。
婚合自然生貴子。萬般謀望趁明時。
jieyue: 此籤可謀財。可望事。若有現成。不圖自至。不勞心力。
訟已決。名利成。病則愈。婚則成。凡事皆成就也。
shiyi: 花在上實在下。功名謀望。若在晚景。求則得之。
不勞心力。早年未遂。病(者)。有孕吉。無孕凶。
問婚。得舊配。問孕生女。謀事夏秋則吉。
璧玉池中開白蓮者。乃仙所有。有疑是空談之說。占者慎之。

reading.zh-CN: 这支签讲的是盛衰无常：花开总有花落，荣华得失也在一生之中轮转。眼下的名利像过眼的花，开头也许顺意，后面却容易落空，所以不宜再贪进。此时最要紧的是收敛锋芒、守住已有，不被一时的得意冲昏头，也不因一时的失意灰心。顺境不骄、逆境不馁，日子才会慢慢回到正轨。
reading.zh-TW: 這支籤講的是盛衰無常：花開總有花落，榮華得失也在一生之中輪轉。眼下的名利像過眼的花，開頭也許順意，後面卻容易落空，所以不宜再貪進。此時最要緊的是收斂鋒芒、守住已有，不被一時的得意衝昏頭，也不因一時的失意灰心。順境不驕、逆境不餒，日子才會慢慢回到正軌。
reading.en: This lot speaks of the turning of fortune: every bloom must fall, and gain and loss take their turns over a lifetime. Fame and profit now are like passing blossoms; things may start pleasantly but are likely to come to nothing, so this is not the time to push for more. What matters most is to draw in, keep what you already have, and neither lose your head over a moment of success nor lose heart over a setback. Stay humble in good times and steady in hard ones, and life will gradually return to its proper course.

tale.zh-CN: 春秋末年，吴国打败越国，越王勾践在会稽低声下气地向吴国求和，此后卧薪尝胆，立志报仇。据《吴越春秋》等书记载，他与大夫范蠡、文种商议，从民间选出绝色美女西施，献给吴王夫差。夫差十分宠爱西施，沉迷享乐，荒废了国事。越国则在暗中积蓄力量，日渐强盛，终于发兵灭了吴国，夫差昔日的荣华富贵转眼成空。正如这支签所说，花开花谢都在春风里，盛极之时更要懂得收敛，不为一时的得意所迷，才能守得长久。
